recipes.name: Gochujang Honey Chicken

req.l: Scallions and sesame seeds to finish

steps: Whisk gochujang, soy, honey, sesame oil, garlic, ginger and vinegar in the cooker.
Add thighs and turn to coat. No added liquid; the chicken releases plenty.
Cook until thighs shred easily.
Lift out and shred. Whisk the slurry into the sauce, cover on HIGH 10–15 min until glossy, then return the chicken.
Finish: Scallions, sesame seeds, a squeeze of lime.

serve.bike: over farro or rice with quick-pickled cucumber.
serve.rest: lettuce cups with a scoop of rice.

recipes.note: Sweet-spicy gochujang flavor with almost no hands-on time.

recipes.name: Chicken Tinga

req.l: 1 tsp Mexican oregano, 1 tsp cumin, 2 bay leaves

steps: Blend tomatoes, chipotles, adobo, garlic, oregano and cumin until smooth.
Layer sliced onion in the cooker, top with chicken, pour sauce over, tuck in bay leaves.
Cook until chicken shreds easily.
Shred in the pot, stir in vinegar, and let it sit 15 min uncovered on HIGH to tighten.
Finish: Lime, cilantro, crumbled cotija or a spoon of Greek yogurt. Avocado day-of only.

serve.bike: corn tortillas or tostadas with black beans.
serve.strength: over shredded cabbage and pickled onions.

recipes.note: Heat level scales with chipotle count. Two is warm; four is properly hot.

recipes.name: Salsa Verde Chicken & White Bean Chili
steps: Add everything except the Neufchâtel to the cooker.
Cook until the chicken shreds easily.
Shred chicken in the pot. Mash about a cup of beans against the side to thicken.
Stir in the Neufchâtel until melted.
Finish: Lime, cilantro, sliced jalapeño, a spoon of Greek yogurt.

serve.rest: as-is with a small side salad.

recipes.note: The cream cheese is optional; skip it and stir in 1/2 cup Greek yogurt off-heat instead for +5g protein and less fat.

recipes.name: Lighter Butter Chicken

req.l: 2.5 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cubed
2 tbsp garam masala, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp cayenne

steps: Optional but worth it: melt butter in a skillet, cook onion 8 min until golden, add garlic, ginger, tomato paste and spices for 1 min.
Scrape into the cooker with tomatoes and chicken; stir.
Cook until chicken is tender.
Off heat, temper the yogurt with a ladle of sauce, then stir it and the cream into the pot.
Finish: Cilantro, a squeeze of lemon, kasuri methi if you have it.
recipes.note: Greek yogurt replaces most of the cream: same silkiness, roughly half the fat of a classic version.

recipes.name: Chicken Saag

req.l: 2.5 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cubed
2 tsp garam masala, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp turmeric
1 lb frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed

steps: Bloom spices in oil with onion, garlic, ginger and chile (skillet, 5 min), or add straight to the cooker on busy days.
Add chicken and tomatoes. Cook until tender.
Stir in spinach for the last 30 min.
Off heat, stir in yogurt. Blitz a few pulses with an immersion blender if you like it smoother.
Finish: Lemon juice and a pinch of garam masala.

serve.rest: with a small portion of rice.

recipes.note: One of the highest protein-per-calorie curries in the set.

recipes.name: Greek Lemon Chicken & Chickpeas

req.l: 1 tbsp dried oregano, 1 tsp smoked paprika

steps: Toss chicken with oil, oregano, paprika, lemon zest, salt and pepper.
Layer onion, garlic and chickpeas in the cooker; set chicken on top; pour broth around.
Cook until tender. Add olives in the last 30 min.
Stir in lemon juice just before serving.
Finish: Feta, fresh dill or parsley, more lemon. A dollop of tzatziki is great.

serve.strength: over a big chopped cucumber-tomato salad.

recipes.note: Lemon juice goes in at the end; long-cooked lemon turns bitter.

recipes.name: Chicken Cacciatore

req.l: 2 tsp Italian seasoning, pinch chili flakes, 2 bay leaves

steps: Optional: sear seasoned thighs 3 min per side for deeper flavor.
Add vegetables to the cooker, chicken on top, then tomatoes, wine, paste and seasonings.
Cook until tender. Stir in capers for the last 15 min.
Finish: Basil, parsley, grated Parmesan.

serve.strength: over broccoli rabe or roasted broccoli.
serve.rest: over a half portion of farro.

recipes.name: Thai Red Curry Chicken & Sweet Potato

req.l: 2.5 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cubed

steps: Whisk curry paste into the coconut milk with fish sauce, sugar, garlic and ginger.
Add sweet potato and onion first (they need the most heat), then chicken and pepper. Pour sauce over.
Cook until sweet potato is tender. Add broccoli for the last 30 min on HIGH.
Finish: Lime juice, Thai basil or cilantro, chopped peanuts.

serve.strength: as-is; the sweet potato covers carbs.

recipes.note: Light coconut milk keeps fat in check; full-fat adds ~90 kcal per serving.

recipes.name: Chicken Tortilla Soup

req.l: 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp oregano

steps: Add everything to the cooker.
Cook until chicken shreds easily.
Shred chicken in the pot and adjust salt and lime.
Finish: Lime, cilantro, crushed tortilla strips, Greek yogurt. Avocado day-of only.

serve.bike: a generous handful of tortilla strips or a quesadilla on the side.

recipes.note: Freeze without toppings; tortilla strips go on fresh.

recipes.name: Chicken Pozole Verde
steps: Broil tomatillos, poblanos, jalapeño and onion 8–10 min until charred (or skip for a brighter, sharper soup).
Blend charred veg with garlic, cilantro and 1 cup broth.
Add sauce, chicken, hominy, remaining broth and spices to the cooker. Cook until chicken shreds.
Shred chicken in the pot and season.
Finish: Shredded cabbage, radish, lime, oregano, sliced jalapeño.

serve.strength: load with cabbage and extra chicken.

recipes.note: The raw cabbage and radish topping is the dish; don't skip it.

recipes.name: Moroccan Chicken with Apricots & Chickpeas

req.l: 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1 tsp ginger, 1 tsp turmeric

steps: Rub chicken with spices and salt.
Add onion, carrots, garlic, chickpeas and apricots to the cooker; chicken on top; pour tomatoes and broth around.
Cook until tender.
Finish: Lemon, cilantro, toasted almonds, a spoon of Greek yogurt.

recipes.name: Filipino Chicken Adobo

req.l: 1 tbsp whole black peppercorns, 4 bay leaves

steps: Add everything to the cooker and turn the chicken to coat.
Cook until tender.
For crisp edges, broil thighs on a sheet pan 4–5 min, then return to the sauce; reduce sauce on the stove if you want it glossy.
Finish: Scallions, a fried egg for extra protein.

serve.strength: with sautéed greens or green beans.

recipes.note: Five-minute prep. A pantry-only weeknight hero.

recipes.name: Chicken & Wild Rice Soup

req.l: 1 tsp thyme, 1 tsp rosemary, 2 bay leaves

steps: Add everything except the milk and flour to the cooker.
Cook until rice is tender and chicken shreds.
Shred chicken. Whisk flour into milk, stir in, and cook on HIGH 20 min to thicken.
Finish: Parsley, black pepper, a squeeze of lemon.

serve.strength: add extra chicken or a side of Greek yogurt.

recipes.note: Wild rice keeps its chew much better than white rice in long cooks.

recipes.name: Jerk Chicken Thighs

req.l: Juice of 2 limes + 1/4 cup orange juice
1 tbsp allspice, 2 tsp thyme, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1/2 tsp nutmeg

steps: Blend everything except chicken into a marinade. Marinate overnight if you can.
Add chicken and marinade to the cooker. Cook until tender.
Broil on a sheet pan 4–5 min for char, then spoon reduced sauce over.
Finish: Lime wedges, scallions, quick pineapple salsa.

serve.bike: rice and peas (coconut rice with kidney beans).

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma Thighs

req.l: 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp turmeric, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1/2 tsp allspice

steps: Mix oil, lemon, garlic and spices; coat chicken. Marinate overnight if possible.
Layer onion in the cooker, chicken on top. No added liquid.
Cook until tender. Slice or chop, then broil 3–4 min on a sheet pan for crisp edges.
Finish: Garlic yogurt sauce or tahini, pickled onions, chopped parsley.

serve.bike: in pita or over farro with hummus.
serve.strength: over a chopped salad with yogurt sauce.

recipes.note: The broil step turns slow-cooked chicken into something that tastes cooked on a spit.

recipes.name: Tuscan Chicken with Sun-Dried Tomatoes

req.l: 1/2 cup oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, drained and chopped
2 tsp Italian seasoning, pinch chili flakes

steps: Season chicken; add to cooker with sun-dried tomatoes, garlic, broth and seasoning.
Cook until tender.
Stir in Neufchâtel and Parmesan until smooth, then fold in spinach until wilted (on HIGH, 10 min).
Finish: Basil and extra Parmesan.
recipes.note: Creamy comfort food that is still high in protein.

recipes.name: Peanut Chicken & Broccoli
steps: Whisk peanut butter, soy, honey, vinegar, sriracha, garlic, ginger and broth in the cooker.
Add chicken and turn to coat. Cook until tender.
Add broccoli and pepper for the last 30–40 min on HIGH.
Finish: Lime, cilantro, chopped peanuts, scallions.

serve.bike: over rice noodles or jasmine rice.

recipes.name: Classic Chicken Noodle Soup

req.l: 1 tsp thyme, 2 bay leaves, parsley stems

steps: Add everything except noodles to the cooker.
Cook until chicken shreds. Shred in the pot.
Add noodles for the final 20–25 min on HIGH, or cook separately so they don't bloat in leftovers.
Finish: Dill or parsley, lemon, black pepper.

serve.bike: add more noodles or crusty bread.
serve.strength: skip noodles and add extra chicken.

recipes.note: Freeze the broth and chicken without noodles; add noodles fresh when reheating.

recipes.name: Classic Beef Stew

req.l: 1 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp thyme, 2 bay leaves

steps: Toss beef with flour, salt and pepper. Sear in oil in batches until deeply browned. Don't crowd the pan.
Deglaze the skillet with wine, scraping up the fond, and pour into the cooker.
Add vegetables, tomato paste, broth and seasonings; beef on top.
Cook until beef is fork-tender. Stir in peas for the last 15 min.
Finish: Parsley and a splash of red wine vinegar to wake it up.

serve.strength: swap half the potatoes for turnips.

recipes.note: Searing is where the stew flavor comes from. If you skip anything, skip the flour, not the sear.

recipes.name: Beef Barbacoa

req.l: 3 lb chuck roast, trimmed, cut into 4 chunks
Juice of 2 limes, 2 tbsp cider vinegar
1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp oregano, 1/2 tsp cloves, 3 bay leaves

steps: Blend chipotles, adobo, onion, garlic, lime, vinegar, broth and spices.
Add beef to the cooker, pour sauce over, tuck in bay leaves.
Cook until it shreds with a fork. Shred and let it soak in the juices 20 min.
Finish: Cilantro, diced onion, lime, pickled jalapeños.

serve.bike: tacos on corn tortillas or a burrito bowl with rice and beans.

recipes.name: Korean Shredded Beef
steps: Mix pear, soy, gochujang, sugar, sesame oil, garlic and ginger.
Layer onion in the cooker, add beef, pour sauce over.
Cook until it shreds. Shred in the pot; skim fat.
Finish: Scallions, sesame seeds, kimchi.

serve.bike: rice bowls with kimchi and a fried egg.

recipes.note: The pear is a tenderizer and the classic bulgogi sweetness, not just flavor.

recipes.name: Beef Ragù

req.l: 1 onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery ribs, finely diced
1 Parmesan rind, 2 bay leaves, 1 tsp oregano

steps: Sear the whole roast on all sides in oil. Sweat the soffritto in the same pan 6–8 min, add paste for 1 min, deglaze with wine.
Add everything to the cooker with tomatoes, rind and herbs.
Cook until the beef falls apart. Remove rind and bay, shred the beef directly into the sauce.
Finish: Parmesan, basil, a drizzle of good olive oil.

serve.strength: over roasted broccoli or spaghetti squash.

recipes.note: Makes a lot. Freezes perfectly in 2-serving portions.

recipes.name: Beef & Bean Chili

req.l: 3 tbsp chili powder, 1 tbsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tbsp cocoa

steps: Brown beef hard without stirring for a crust, then break up. Add onion, pepper and garlic for 3 min.
Bloom the spices in the pan for 1 minute, then scrape everything into the cooker.
Add beans, tomatoes and broth. Cook, then adjust salt and a splash of vinegar.
Finish: Greek yogurt, sharp cheddar, scallions, pickled jalapeños.

serve.bike: over a baked potato or with cornbread.

recipes.note: Ground meat should never go into a slow cooker raw for chili; the texture turns grainy and greasy.

recipes.name: Beef Bourguignon

req.l: 2 cups dry red wine (Burgundy or Pinot)

steps: Crisp the bacon; remove. Flour-dust the beef and sear in the fat in batches.
Deglaze with a cup of the wine; scrape into the cooker with everything else except mushrooms.
Cook. Brown the mushrooms separately and stir in for the last 30 min.
Finish: Parsley. It's better on day two.

serve.bike: over mashed potatoes or egg noodles.

recipes.note: Treat-tier for fat and alcohol, but the wine mostly cooks off over 8 hours.

recipes.name: Ropa Vieja

req.l: 2.5 lb flank steak or chuck, trimmed
2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp oregano, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 2 bay leaves

steps: Season beef with cumin, oregano, paprika, salt and pepper.
Add peppers, onion and garlic to the cooker; beef on top; pour tomatoes, paste and broth over.
Cook until it shreds. Shred, stir in olives and vinegar, rest 15 min.
Finish: Cilantro. Fried sweet plantains if it's a bike day.

recipes.name: Mongolian Beef

req.l: 2 lb flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain

steps: Toss sliced beef in cornstarch (this is your velveting step and also thickens the sauce).
Whisk soy, sugar, water, garlic, ginger and sesame oil in the cooker. Add beef.
Cook on LOW only; flank toughens if overcooked. Add broccoli and scallions for the last 30 min on HIGH.
Finish: Sesame seeds, chili flakes.
recipes.note: Halved the usual sugar. Still sweet; flag for occasional rotation.

recipes.name: Galbi Jjim (Braised Short Ribs)
steps: Optional: parboil ribs 5 min and rinse for a cleaner sauce (traditional), or sear for deeper flavor.
Mix soy, pear, sugar, garlic, ginger and sesame oil. Add vegetables, ribs and sauce to the cooker.
Cook until meltingly tender. Chill overnight and lift off the fat cap before reheating; this matters a lot here.
Finish: Scallions, sesame seeds, jujubes or chestnuts if you have them.
recipes.note: Highest-fat recipe in the set even after skimming. A special-occasion braise.

recipes.name: Beef Massaman Curry

req.l: 1 cinnamon stick, 3 cardamom pods, 2 tbsp tamarind or lime juice

steps: Whisk curry paste into coconut milk with fish sauce and sugar.
Add potatoes and onion, then beef and whole spices. Pour sauce over.
Cook until beef is tender. Stir in peanuts and tamarind or lime at the end.
Finish: Cilantro, more peanuts, lime.

recipes.name: Italian Beef

req.l: 1 (16-oz) jar giardiniera or pepperoncini + some brine
1 tbsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp red pepper flakes, 1 tsp black pepper

steps: Add beef, broth, garlic, seasonings and peppers with 1/4 cup brine to the cooker.
Cook until it shreds easily; shred in the jus.
Finish: Provolone if making sandwiches; more giardiniera.

serve.strength: over arugula salad with peppers and shaved Parmesan.

recipes.note: The beef itself is lean and high-protein; the roll is what makes it a treat.

recipes.name: Deli-Style Braised Brisket

req.l: 2 tbsp red wine vinegar, 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp thyme

steps: Season and sear the brisket well on both sides.
Bed onions, garlic and carrots in the cooker. Set brisket fat-side up.
Whisk paste, broth, wine, sugar, vinegar and spices; pour over. Cook until tender.
Chill overnight, slice cold against the grain, skim fat, and reheat slices in the sauce.
Finish: Horseradish, parsley.
recipes.note: Slicing cold is the trick to clean slices instead of shreds.

recipes.name: Beef & Barley Soup

req.l: 1 tbsp Worcestershire, 1 tsp thyme, 2 bay leaves

steps: Sear the beef in batches.
Add everything to the cooker.
Cook until beef is tender and barley is plump. Thin with broth when reheating; barley keeps drinking.
Finish: Parsley, black pepper.
recipes.note: Barley is one of the best slow-cooker grains; it holds its shape far better than rice or pasta.

recipes.name: Unstuffed Cabbage Roll Soup

req.l: 2 tbsp cider vinegar, 1 tbsp brown sugar
2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp dill, 1 tsp thyme

steps: Brown beef with onion and garlic.
Add everything except rice to the cooker. Cook.
Stir in rice for the last 45 min on HIGH.
Finish: Dill and a spoon of Greek yogurt.
recipes.note: All the flavor of golabki with none of the rolling.

recipes.name: Hungarian Goulash

req.l: 3 tbsp sweet Hungarian paprika + 1 tsp hot paprika

steps: Cook onions in oil until deeply golden (15 min). This is the backbone of the dish.
Off heat, stir in the paprika (paprika scorches easily) and tomato paste.
Add onions, beef, peppers, garlic, broth and spices to the cooker. Cook until tender.
Finish: Greek yogurt in place of sour cream, parsley.
recipes.note: Onion caramelization does more for this than anything else.

recipes.name: Carnitas

req.l: 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp oregano, 1 tsp chili powder, 2 bay leaves

steps: Rub pork with spices and salt. Add to cooker with onion, garlic, bay and citrus.
Cook until it shreds.
Shred, spread on a sheet pan, drizzle with some cooking liquid, broil 5–7 min until crisp at the edges.
Finish: Cilantro, onion, lime, salsa verde.
recipes.note: The broil step is non-negotiable. It's the difference between pulled pork and carnitas.

recipes.name: BBQ Pulled Pork

req.l: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp mustard powder, 1 tsp cayenne

steps: Rub pork with spices and salt.
Bed onion in the cooker, add pork, vinegar and half the BBQ sauce.
Cook until it shreds. Shred, skim fat, and toss with remaining sauce.
Finish: Vinegar slaw, pickles.
recipes.note: Vinegar-forward Carolina style keeps sugar down versus sauce-drowned versions.

recipes.name: Pork Chile Verde
steps: Broil tomatillos, peppers and onion until blistered; blend with garlic, cilantro and broth.
Add pork and sauce to the cooker with spices.
Cook until pork is tender. Skim fat.
Finish: Lime, more cilantro, Greek yogurt.

recipes.name: Kalua-Style Pork & Cabbage

req.l: 1 tbsp Hawaiian or coarse sea salt
1/2 head green cabbage, cut into wedges

steps: Pierce pork all over; rub with salt and liquid smoke.
Cook until it shreds. Add cabbage wedges for the last hour.
Shred pork into the juices with the cabbage.
Finish: Green onion, a squeeze of lime.
recipes.note: Three ingredients. The easiest high-protein batch in the database.

recipes.name: Pork Tenderloin with Apples & Dijon
steps: Rub tenderloins with Dijon, maple, herbs, salt and pepper.
Bed apples and onion in the cooker; set pork on top; pour broth around.
Cook only to 145°F (start checking at 3 hours on LOW). Rest 10 min, then slice.
Finish: Spoon apples and juices over; parsley.

serve.strength: with roasted Brussels sprouts or green beans.

recipes.note: Tenderloin is lean and dries out with long cooks. Use a probe thermometer; this is the one recipe here that can't be left all day.

recipes.name: Pozole Rojo

req.l: 4 dried guajillo + 2 ancho chiles, stemmed, seeded, soaked
1 tbsp oregano, 2 tsp cumin, 2 bay leaves

steps: Blend soaked chiles with garlic, half the onion and 1 cup broth until very smooth; strain.
Add pork, sauce, remaining onion, broth and spices to the cooker. Cook until tender.
Shred pork, add hominy for the last 30 min.
Finish: Shredded cabbage, radish, lime, oregano, chile flakes.

recipes.name: Char Siu-Style Pork

req.l: 1 tsp five-spice, 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine or dry sherry

steps: Mix hoisin, soy, honey, garlic, five-spice and wine. Reserve 3 tbsp for glazing.
Coat pork and cook until tender.
Slice or shred, brush with reserved sauce, broil 3–5 min until lacquered.
Finish: Scallions, sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Cuban Mojo Pork

req.l: 1/2 cup orange juice + juice of 3 limes

steps: Mix juice, garlic, oil, cumin, oregano and salt into a mojo. Marinate pork overnight if possible.
Bed onion in the cooker; add pork and marinade.
Cook until it shreds. Shred and broil to crisp the edges.
Finish: Pickled red onion, cilantro.

recipes.name: Red Beans & Rice

req.l: 1 lb dried red kidney beans, soaked overnight
1 onion, 1 bell pepper, 3 celery ribs, diced
2 tsp Cajun seasoning, 1 tsp thyme, 2 bay leaves, hot sauce

steps: SAFETY: boil soaked kidney beans hard for 10 minutes and drain. Slow cookers don't get hot enough to destroy the bean toxin on their own.
Brown andouille in a skillet. Add everything to the cooker.
Cook until beans are creamy. Mash some against the side to thicken.
Finish: Scallions, hot sauce, a splash of vinegar.
recipes.note: Kidney beans must be boiled first. Undercooked kidney beans cause real food poisoning.

recipes.name: Split Pea Soup with Ham

req.l: 1 lb dried green split peas, rinsed
12 oz extra-lean ham, diced (or a ham hock)

steps: Add everything to the cooker; no soaking needed.
Cook until peas collapse. Stir hard or blend partially.
Thin with water when reheating; it sets firm overnight.
Finish: Black pepper, a splash of vinegar, croutons.
recipes.note: Very high fiber and very cheap; a protein workhorse at about a dollar a serving.

recipes.name: Pork & White Bean Cassoulet
steps: Sear pork and sausage; set aside.
Add soaked beans, vegetables, tomatoes, broth and herbs to the cooker; nestle meat on top.
Cook until beans are creamy. Optional: top with toasted breadcrumbs and parsley before serving.
Finish: Toasted garlic breadcrumbs, parsley.
recipes.note: Chicken sausage stands in for duck confit and pork sausage: same spirit, a fraction of the fat.

recipes.name: Pork Vindaloo

req.l: 6 dried Kashmiri chiles, soaked (or 2 tbsp Kashmiri chili powder)
2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp mustard seed, 1 tsp turmeric, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp cloves

steps: Blend chiles, vinegar, garlic, ginger and spices to a paste. Marinate pork overnight.
Brown onions in oil until deep golden; add with pork, marinade and paste to the cooker.
Cook until tender. Season with salt and a little brown sugar if too sharp.
Finish: Cilantro, sliced onion.

recipes.name: Turkey & Sweet Potato Chili

req.l: 3 tbsp chili powder, 1 tbsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cinnamon

steps: Brown turkey hard, undisturbed, for a crust. Add onion, pepper, garlic and spices for 2 min.
Scrape into the cooker with everything else.
Cook until sweet potato is tender.
Finish: Lime, cilantro, Greek yogurt, pickled red onion.

serve.strength: as-is; it's balanced on its own.

recipes.name: Turkey Meatballs in Marinara

req.l: 1/4 cup parsley, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp fennel seed

steps: Mix turkey, eggs, Parmesan, breadcrumbs, garlic, herbs and salt. Roll into 24 balls.
Pour half the sauce into the cooker, add meatballs in a single layer if possible, cover with remaining sauce.
Cook without stirring for the first 2 hours so they set.
Finish: Basil, extra Parmesan, a little fresh mozzarella.

serve.bike: over spaghetti or in sub rolls.
serve.rest: over a half portion of pasta.

recipes.note: Optional: broil the meatballs 5 min before adding for better texture.

recipes.name: Turkey & Lentil Taco Filling

req.l: 1 (14.5-oz) can diced tomatoes with green chiles
2 tbsp chili powder, 1 tbsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp oregano

steps: Brown turkey with onion and garlic.
Add to cooker with lentils, tomatoes, broth and spices.
Cook until lentils are tender and liquid is mostly absorbed. Cook uncovered 20 min on HIGH if loose.
Finish: Lime, cilantro, salsa, shredded lettuce, cheddar.
recipes.note: Lentils stretch the meat, double the fiber, and disappear into the texture.

recipes.name: Herb Turkey Breast with Pan Gravy
steps: Rub turkey with butter, herbs, salt and pepper.
Set on top of vegetables in the cooker; add broth.
Cook to 160°F, then rest 15 min. Strain liquid into a pan, whisk in cornstarch slurry, simmer to gravy.
Finish: Cranberry sauce, parsley.

serve.strength: with green beans and roasted broccoli.

recipes.note: The leanest protein in the database. Slice and portion for a week of lunches.

recipes.name: Turkey Keema with Peas

req.l: 1 tbsp garam masala, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp turmeric

steps: Brown turkey and onions until golden; add garlic, ginger, chile and spices for 1 min.
Add to cooker with tomatoes. Cook.
Stir in peas for the last 20 min, and yogurt off heat.
Finish: Cilantro, lemon.

serve.strength: in lettuce cups or over cauliflower.

recipes.name: Turkey Bolognese

req.l: 1 onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery ribs, finely diced
1 Parmesan rind, 1 tsp oregano, pinch nutmeg

steps: Brown turkey hard; add soffritto and cook 6 min, then paste 1 min. Deglaze with wine.
Add to cooker with tomatoes, milk, rind and seasonings.
Cook. Remove rind; season.
Finish: Parmesan, basil.

serve.strength: over roasted broccoli or spaghetti squash.

recipes.note: Milk is traditional; it softens the acidity and tenderizes the meat.

recipes.name: Unstuffed Pepper Soup with Farro

req.l: 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp smoked paprika

steps: Brown turkey with onion and garlic.
Add everything except farro to the cooker. Cook.
Stir in farro for the last 60–75 min on HIGH.
Finish: Parmesan or a little shredded mozzarella, parsley.
recipes.note: All the flavor of stuffed peppers, without the stuffing and baking.

recipes.name: Lamb Tagine with Chickpeas

req.l: Ras el hanout 2 tbsp (or cumin, coriander, cinnamon, ginger), pinch saffron

steps: Toss lamb with spices and salt; sear in batches.
Add everything to the cooker.
Cook until lamb is tender. Skim fat before serving.
Finish: Cilantro, toasted almonds, preserved lemon or lemon zest.

recipes.name: Lamb Rogan Josh

req.l: 2 tbsp Kashmiri chili, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp fennel, 4 cardamom pods, 1 cinnamon stick

steps: Brown onions deeply in oil; add garlic, ginger, paste and spices for 1 min.
Sear lamb. Add everything except the yogurt to the cooker with 1/2 cup water.
Cook until tender. Temper yogurt and stir in off heat.
Finish: Cilantro.

recipes.name: Greek Lamb with Lemon Potatoes

req.l: 2.5 lb lamb shoulder, trimmed, large chunks
Zest + juice of 2 lemons, 1 tbsp oregano, rosemary

steps: Rub lamb with garlic, oregano, rosemary, lemon zest, salt and pepper.
Bed potatoes and onion in the cooker; lamb on top; add broth and wine.
Cook until lamb falls apart. Add lemon juice at the end; finish with feta.
Finish: Feta, parsley, lemon, tzatziki.

serve.strength: swap half the potatoes for green beans.

recipes.note: Kleftiko-style without the parchment parcel.

recipes.name: Cioppino

req.l: 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp oregano, pinch chili flakes, 2 bay leaves

steps: Add everything except seafood to the cooker. Cook the base.
Turn to HIGH. Add fish for 20 min, then shrimp for the final 10 min, until just opaque.
Seafood should never go in at the start; it goes rubbery.
Finish: Parsley, lemon, chili flakes.
recipes.note: Freeze only the tomato-fennel base; seafood should be cooked fresh.

recipes.name: Shrimp & Chicken Sausage Jambalaya

req.l: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cubed
1 onion, 1 bell pepper, 3 celery ribs, diced
1 tbsp Cajun seasoning, 1 tsp thyme, 2 bay leaves

steps: Add everything except shrimp to the cooker. Cook.
Add shrimp for the last 15 min on HIGH.
Cook rice separately and fold in, or serve over it. Rice cooked in a slow cooker turns to paste.
Finish: Scallions, parsley, hot sauce.

serve.bike: folded into 1 cup cooked rice per serving.

recipes.note: Macros shown are for the stew without rice.

recipes.name: Coconut Fish Curry

req.l: 2 lb cod or other firm white fish, 2-inch chunks
1 tsp mustard seed, 1 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp Kashmiri chili, 1 tsp coriander, curry leaves
1 tbsp tamarind paste or lime juice

steps: Add everything except fish and tamarind to the cooker; cook the base.
Turn to HIGH, slide in fish, cook 20–30 min until it flakes.
Stir in tamarind or lime gently.
Finish: Cilantro, lime.
recipes.note: Leanest curry in the set.

recipes.name: Cuban Black Bean Soup

req.l: 1 lb dried black beans, soaked overnight
2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp oregano, 2 bay leaves
2 tbsp sherry or red wine vinegar

steps: Add everything except vinegar to the cooker.
Cook until beans are very tender.
Blend about half, stir in vinegar, and season.
Finish: Greek yogurt, red onion, cilantro, hard-boiled egg (traditional and +6g protein).

serve.strength: top with 2 chopped eggs and a side of chicken.

recipes.note: On its own this is a carb-forward pot; pair with eggs or yogurt to hit protein.

recipes.name: Red Lentil Dal

req.l: 1 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander
Tadka: 1 tbsp ghee or oil, 1 tsp cumin seed, 1 tsp mustard seed, 2 dried chiles

steps: Add lentils, onion, garlic, ginger, tomatoes, water and ground spices.
Cook until lentils collapse. Stir in spinach.
Fry the tadka in a small pan until seeds pop and pour sizzling over the dal.
Finish: Lemon, cilantro, Greek yogurt.

serve.strength: with a side of chicken or 2 eggs.

recipes.note: The tadka at the end is what makes it taste restaurant-grade.

recipes.name: Chana Masala

req.l: 2 tbsp chana masala or garam masala, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp amchur

steps: Brown onions in oil (worth it); add garlic, ginger, chile and spices for 1 min.
Add to cooker with chickpeas, tomatoes and water.
Cook until chickpeas are creamy. Mash a few to thicken.
Finish: Lemon, cilantro, sliced onion, Greek yogurt.

recipes.name: Tuscan White Bean & Kale Soup

req.l: 1 Parmesan rind, rosemary, thyme, 2 bay leaves

steps: Add beans, vegetables, tomatoes, broth, rind and herbs.
Cook until beans are creamy. Add kale for the last 30 min.
Remove rind. Stir in Parmesan and a good drizzle of olive oil.
Finish: Parmesan, olive oil, chili flakes, lemon.
recipes.note: Add 12 oz chicken sausage to push it from 'side' into 'main' protein territory.

recipes.name: Three-Bean Vegetarian Chili

req.l: 3 tbsp chili powder, 1 tbsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp cocoa

steps: Add everything to the cooker.
Cook until lentils are tender and chili is thick.
Finish: Greek yogurt, cheddar, scallions, avocado day-of.

serve.strength: top with Greek yogurt and a fried egg.

recipes.note: Lentils give it a meaty body without any meat.

recipes.name: Lentil Bolognese

req.l: 1.5 cups dried brown or green lentils
1 onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery ribs, finely diced
1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp basil

steps: Add everything to the cooker.
Cook until lentils are tender and sauce is thick.
Finish: Parmesan, basil.

serve.strength: stir in cottage cheese or top with Parmesan and serve over broccoli.

recipes.name: Smoky Black-Eyed Peas & Collards

req.l: 1 lb dried black-eyed peas, rinsed (no soak needed)
8 oz turkey bacon or smoked turkey, chopped
1 bunch collard greens, stems removed, sliced
1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, 2 bay leaves

steps: Add everything except vinegar to the cooker.
Cook until peas are tender.
Stir in vinegar and hot sauce to taste.
Finish: Hot sauce, chopped onion.

serve.bike: over rice (Hoppin' John) or with cornbread.

recipes.name: Gochujang Tofu & Chickpea Stew
steps: Add everything except tofu to the cooker. Cook.
Add tofu for the last 45 min so it stays intact.
Finish: Scallions, a soft egg, sesame seeds.
recipes.note: Plant-based and still a genuine protein main.

recipes.name: White Bean Minestrone
steps: Add everything except pasta, spinach and Parmesan. Cook.
Stir in pasta for the last 25 min on HIGH and spinach at the end.
Stir in Parmesan to serve.
Finish: Pesto swirl, Parmesan, olive oil.

serve.strength: skip pasta, add 1 lb chicken sausage.

recipes.note: On its own this is a lighter, lower-protein pot; treat as a side or add a protein.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato, Chickpea & Spinach Curry

req.l: 2 tbsp curry powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric

steps: Add everything except spinach.
Cook until sweet potatoes are tender. Stir in spinach.
Finish: Lime, cilantro, Greek yogurt.

serve.strength: pair with chicken or top with a fried egg.

recipes.note: Hearty and filling; the sweet potatoes make it a meal on their own.

recipes.name: Charro Beans

req.l: 8 oz turkey kielbasa or chicken sausage, sliced

steps: Crisp bacon; add sausage and onion for 3 min.
Add to the cooker with beans, jalapeños, garlic, tomatoes, broth and spices.
Cook until beans are creamy.
Finish: Cilantro, lime.
recipes.note: Works as a side to any of the pulled meats or as a light main.

recipes.name: Mushroom & Barley Stew

req.l: 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp thyme, 1 tsp dill, 2 bay leaves

steps: Add everything to the cooker.
Cook until barley and lentils are tender. Thin with broth as needed.
Finish: Dill, Greek yogurt, black pepper.
recipes.note: Lentils added to the classic to make it a real meal.

recipes.name: Rajma (Kidney Bean Curry)

req.l: 1 lb dried kidney beans, soaked overnight
2 tsp garam masala, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp Kashmiri chili

steps: SAFETY: boil soaked kidney beans hard for 10 minutes and drain before they go in the cooker.
Brown onions in oil; add garlic, ginger and spices for 1 min.
Add everything to the cooker. Cook until beans are creamy; mash a few to thicken.
Finish: Cilantro, lemon, Greek yogurt.

serve.bike: rajma chawal, over rice as intended.

recipes.note: Kidney beans must be boiled first. See the safety note.

recipes.name: West African Peanut Stew

req.l: 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1/2 tsp cinnamon

steps: Whisk peanut butter into the broth.
Add everything except greens to the cooker. Cook.
Stir in greens for the last 30 min.
Finish: Chopped peanuts, cilantro, lime.

serve.strength: add shredded chicken thighs (classic maafe uses chicken).

recipes.note: Add 2 lb chicken thighs to the pot for a maafe that clears 35g protein.

recipes.name: Overnight Protein Steel-Cut Oats

req.l: 1 tsp cinnamon, pinch salt, 1 tsp vanilla
To serve: 1/2 cup Greek yogurt per bowl

steps: Grease the cooker well. Add oats, water, milk, apple, cinnamon and salt.
Cook overnight on LOW.
Stir in maple. Top each bowl with Greek yogurt (that's where most of the protein comes from).
Finish: Walnuts, berries, extra cinnamon.

serve.strength: add a scoop of protein powder or side of eggs.

recipes.note: Macros include 1/2 cup Greek yogurt per serving.

recipes.name: Spinach-Feta Egg Bake
steps: Line the cooker with parchment (makes lifting out easy) and grease it.
Whisk eggs, whites and cottage cheese; fold in everything else.
Cook until center is set. Lay a paper towel under the lid to catch condensation.
Finish: Hot sauce, herbs.
recipes.note: Slice into 6 squares; freezes and reheats well for grab-and-go breakfasts.

recipes.name: Mexican Breakfast Casserole
steps: Brown chorizo with pepper and onion; drain fat.
Line and grease the cooker. Whisk eggs and whites; fold in everything.
Cook until set, paper towel under the lid.
Finish: Salsa, cilantro, Greek yogurt.
recipes.note: Chorizo as flavor, not the main protein: a little goes a long way.

recipes.name: Gochujang Beef & Broccoli Farro Bowls
recipes.freezer: Yes (beef + farro; edamame and broccoli keep 4 days)
steps: Simmer farro in salted water 25–30 min until chewy-tender; drain.
Meanwhile, roast frozen broccoli on a sheet pan at 450°F for 20 min, no thawing, so it chars instead of steaming.
Brown the beef in a hot skillet without stirring for 4 min to build a crust, then break up and cook through. Drain excess fat.
Whisk gochujang, tamari, honey, vinegar, sesame oil, garlic and lime. Toss with the beef over low heat until glossy.
Microwave edamame 2 min. Portion farro, beef, broccoli and edamame into 4 containers.

serve.strength: Halve the farro and double the broccoli.

recipes.base: Farro is built into the macros at about 1/2 cup cooked per bowl.

recipes.name: Harissa Chicken & Chickpea Sheet Pan with Feta Yogurt
recipes.freezer: Chicken and chickpeas freeze; keep yogurt sauce separate
steps: Heat oven to 450°F. Toss chicken, chickpeas, carrots and onion with harissa, olive oil, salt and half the lemon juice.
Spread on one large sheet pan (or two; crowding steams). Roast 25 min, flipping once, until chicken hits 165°F and chickpeas crisp at the edges.
Stir yogurt, feta, garlic, remaining lemon and a pinch of salt into a sauce.
Portion with sauce on the side.

serve.bike: Serve over farro or with a warm pita.
serve.strength: Add shredded cabbage dressed with lemon.

recipes.name: Red Curry–Glazed Salmon with Jasmine Rice & Edamame Slaw
steps: Cook rice. Heat oven to 425°F.
Whisk curry paste, honey, fish sauce and 1 tbsp lime. Pat salmon dry, brush with glaze, roast 10–12 min, then broil 1–2 min to caramelize.
Toss cabbage, carrots and edamame with vinegar, sesame oil, remaining lime and a pinch of salt.
Plate salmon over rice with the slaw.

serve.strength: Skip the rice, double the slaw.

recipes.base: Rice is in the macros at about 1/2 cup cooked.

recipes.name: Lemon Tuna & Chickpea Salad with Capers & Artichokes
steps: Soak the diced red onion in the lemon juice for 5 min to tame it.
Whisk in olive oil, mustard, garlic, salt and pepper.
Fold in chickpeas, tuna, artichokes, capers and feta. Taste for salt and acid.
Portion into 4 containers.

recipes.name: Beef & Black Bean Taco Skillet with Lime Crema
steps: Brown beef and onion hard in a large skillet. Add garlic and adobo, cook 1 min.
Add beans, crushed tomatoes and hot sauce. Simmer 8 min until thick.
Stir yogurt with half the lime and a pinch of salt. Toss cabbage with the rest of the lime.
Top skillet with cheese, cover 2 min to melt. Serve with crema and slaw.

recipes.name: Sausage, Broccoli & Hash Brown Egg Bake

req.l: 6 oz frozen sausage, browned and crumbled
2 cups frozen broccoli, thawed and chopped

steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Grease a 9×13. Lay hash brown patties in the bottom and bake 12 min to crisp.
Brown sausage with onion; drain. Scatter over the patties with the broccoli.
Whisk eggs and yogurt until completely smooth (the yogurt makes it custardy and adds protein), season, and pour over. Top with cheese.
Bake 30–35 min until center is set. Rest 10 min before cutting into 6.

serve.strength: Add a cup of Greek yogurt with berries on the side.

recipes.name: Blueberry Peanut Butter Protein Oats
steps: Whisk milk, yogurt, peanut butter, honey and vanilla until smooth.
Stir in oats. Divide into 4 jars and top each with frozen blueberries.
Refrigerate overnight; the berries thaw into a sauce.

serve.bike: Top with granola or a sliced banana.

recipes.name: Greek Lemon Chicken Orzo with Artichokes & Feta
recipes.freezer: Fridge 4 days; freezes OK without the yogurt

req.l: 2 1/2 cups water + 2 tsp Better than Bouillon chicken
2 tbsp lemon juice + zest of 1 lemon

steps: Sear chicken in oil in a wide pot in two batches until golden; set aside.
Soften onion 3 min, add garlic and orzo and toast 1 min.
Add broth, simmer 8 min stirring often. Add broccoli, artichokes and chicken; cook 3–4 min until orzo is tender and chicken is 165°F.
Off heat, stir in yogurt, lemon juice and zest. Top with feta.

serve.strength: Add more broccoli and take a smaller scoop.

recipes.name: Weeknight Beef Ragù Penne with Broccoli
steps: Brown beef without stirring 4 min; break up. Add onion and carrot, cook 5 min.
Add garlic and tomato paste; cook until the paste darkens, 2 min. Add marinara and Worcestershire, simmer 15 min.
Boil penne; add broccoli for the last 3 min. Drain, reserving a splash of water.
Toss with the ragù and nutritional yeast.

serve.strength: Half a portion of pasta with extra ragù and broccoli.

recipes.name: Sambal Beef & Cabbage Egg Roll Bowls
steps: Brown beef hard in a wide skillet; push aside, add onion and garlic.
Add cabbage and carrots over high heat; cook 5–6 min until wilted with some char.
Stir in tamari, sambal and vinegar; finish with sesame oil.
Top each bowl with a jammy or fried egg and a sriracha-mayo drizzle.

recipes.name: Chicken Curry

req.l: 2 oz Massaman curry paste (or red curry paste + 1 tbsp sugar)
Zest and juice of 1 lime, plus wedges for serving
1/4 cup roasted unsalted peanuts, plus more for topping

steps: Whisk 1/2 cup water, the coconut milk, curry paste, fish sauce, ginger, onion and lime zest in a 6- to 8-quart slow cooker. Smash the lemongrass, tie it in a knot and add it with the peanuts and potatoes. Top with the chicken, press to submerge, cover and cook on LOW 7 hours.
Skim off some fat. Stir in the lime juice and season with salt. Break the chicken into chunks and let stand 5 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly; discard the lemongrass.
Serve with rice, topped with peanuts and cilantro, with lime wedges.

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma Bowl

req.l: 2 tbsp shawarma spice blend (or 1 tsp each cumin, paprika, coriander, turmeric, 1/2 tsp cinnamon)
1 red onion, sliced; 1/2 cup vinegar; 1 tsp sugar (quick pickle)

steps: Pickle the onion first: pour the vinegar, sugar and 1/2 tsp salt over the onion and let sit 20 minutes.
Marinate the chicken in the spices, oil, lemon, garlic and salt for 20 minutes or overnight.
Roast the chicken and cauliflower on separate pans at 425°F for 25 minutes, then broil the chicken 2–3 minutes to char. Slice.
Build bowls with 1/2 cup rice, hummus, cauliflower, chicken, pickled onion and herbs.
recipes.note: The pickled onions keep for two weeks and brighten almost any bowl.

recipes.name: Crunchy Thai Chickpea Salad

req.l: Dressing: 1 tbsp honey or maple syrup

steps: Combine the chickpeas, cucumber, bell pepper, carrots and cilantro in a large bowl.
Whisk the lime juice, peanut butter, sesame oil, honey and sriracha until smooth, thinning with a splash of water if needed.
Toss the salad with the dressing and serve, or chill until ready to eat.
recipes.note: No cooking, so it's an easy meal-prep lunch; it holds in the fridge for a few days. Use less sriracha for a milder dressing.

recipes.name: Salmon Cakes

req.l: 1 lb salmon (fresh, canned or leftover cooked)

steps: In a medium pan, sauté the onions and peppers in olive oil and butter for 7 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the salmon, panko, sautéed vegetables, eggs, dill, parsley, lemon juice, Worcestershire, mayo, sour cream, paprika, salt and pepper.
Form into 10 to 12 patties, about 1/3 cup each.
Fry in olive oil and butter over medium heat, 4 minutes per side, until golden and crisp.

recipes.name: Egg, Frittata, and Spinach Wrap

req.l: 6 large flour tortillas or lavash wraps

steps: Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-low with the oil or butter. Whisk the eggs, salt and pepper.
Cook the eggs low and slow, stirring gently. When just barely set, fold in the spinach, scallions and feta and cook 1–2 minutes until the spinach wilts. Remove from heat early.
Divide the filling among the tortillas (about 140 g each), leaving a border, and roll burrito-style.
Optional: toast seam-side down in a dry skillet 2–3 minutes per side.
recipes.note: Fridge: wrap in foil, up to 4 days. Freezer: foil then a freezer bag, up to 2 months. Reheat from frozen in the microwave 1–2 minutes, then toast in a skillet.

recipes.name: Apple Cider Donuts

req.l: 2 cups apple cider, reduced to 1/4 cup
1 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp nutmeg, 1/4 tsp allspice
6 tbsp butter, browned and cooled slightly
Coating: 6 tbsp butter, melted; 3/4 cup granulated sugar; 1 1/2 tsp cinnamon

steps: Boil the cider down to 1/4 cup and let cool.
Whisk the dry ingredients together.
Whisk the brown butter and sugars, then add the eggs one at a time, then the sour cream, buttermilk, cooled cider and vanilla.
Fold wet into dry just until no streaks remain.
Pipe or spoon into a greased donut pan, 3/4 full. Bake at 350°F for 10–12 minutes.
Cool 3–4 minutes, then while warm dip the tops in melted butter and then cinnamon sugar.
recipes.note: Reducing the cider concentrates the apple flavor without making the batter gummy. Don't overmix.

recipes.name: Bean Dip Quesadilla

req.l: Salsa, sour cream or guacamole, to serve (optional)

steps: Mix the beans, taco seasoning and tomato sauce and heat on the stove or in the microwave.
Spread on a tortilla, add cheese and any extras, and top with another tortilla.
Cook in a lightly oiled skillet until crisp and melted. Serve with salsa, sour cream or guacamole.

recipes.name: Heirloom Tomato Tarte Tatin

req.l: 375 g sheet frozen puff pastry, thawed
Basil oil: 1/3 cup olive oil, 1 cup basil leaves, plus extra basil to serve

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a large tray with parchment.

Drizzle the oil over an area slightly smaller than the pastry, sprinkle with the sugar and half the oregano, and season. Arrange the tomatoes overlapping on top, then add the remaining oregano and season again.
Lay the pastry over the tomatoes, press the edges down and cut 3 slits. Bake 25–30 minutes until puffed and caramelized.
Blend the basil oil ingredients with a pinch of salt.
Flip the tray onto a board, peel off the paper, and serve drizzled with basil oil and extra basil.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Rolls
recipes.timeText: 20 min prep, 35 min bake, 1 hr rise

req.l: Filling: 1/4 cup salted butter, softened; 3/4 cup brown sugar; 2 tbsp cinnamon
Frosting: 8 oz cream cheese; 1/2 cup salted butter; 2 cups powdered sugar; 1 tsp vanilla

steps: Whisk 2 cups flour with the sugar and yeast.
Microwave the milk and butter 45 seconds until warm, not hot. Add with the egg to the flour and mix. Add 2 more cups flour, then 1/2 cup, until a soft dough forms.
Knead until smooth and springy, adding up to 1/4 cup more flour if sticky. Rest 10 minutes, then roll to a 15 × 12-inch rectangle.
Spread with the softened butter, sprinkle with the cinnamon sugar, roll from the long side and cut into 12 with unflavored floss.
Place in a buttered 9 × 13 pan, cover and proof 1 hour.
Bake at 350°F for 30–35 minutes. Cool 10–15 minutes.
Beat the frosting ingredients together and spread on the warm rolls.
recipes.note: To freeze, wrap the unbaked, unrisen rolls tightly for up to 2 weeks; thaw and proof 1–2 hours before baking.

recipes.name: Tuna Garbanzo Bean Salad

req.l: 1/4 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper
1 can tuna in water, drained well

steps: Whisk the mayo, oil, lemon juice, mustard, salt, pepper and hot sauce.
Pat the chickpeas dry and mash a few with a fork to help the salad bind.
Add the tuna, celery, onion, capers and dill, pour over the dressing and stir gently.
Serve in a sandwich or wrap, over arugula, or with crackers.

recipes.name: Avocado Breakfast Flatbreads with Pickled White Beans

req.l: 1 (15-oz) can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
1 1/2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, plus extra for drizzling
3 scallions, thinly sliced (whites and greens separated)
Kosher salt and cracked black pepper
1/4 cup pickled jalapeños, diced, plus 1 tbsp brine

steps: Put the beans and nutritional yeast in a bowl.
Warm the oil over medium-low and sauté the scallion whites and garlic with a pinch of salt 2–3 minutes until golden. Pour over the beans and stir.
Add the scallion greens, avocado, herbs, jalapeños and brine, lime zest and juice, agave, salt and pepper. Stir to combine.
Warm the flatbreads, rub with the cut garlic, and spoon the mixture on top.
recipes.note: For meal prep, leave out the avocado and add it right before serving. The mix tastes best after marinating an hour.

recipes.name: Buffalo Deviled Eggs

req.l: Filling: 1 tablespoon Tabasco or Frank's Hot Sauce

steps: Start the eggs in cold water, bring to a boil and cook 6-7 minutes, turning them a few times early on to center the yolks, then chill in very cold water.
Meanwhile fry the diced bacon in a little oil until crisp and set aside.
Peel and halve the eggs lengthwise and remove the yolks.
Melt the butter over medium-high heat with the hot sauce, garlic powder, onion powder and salt.
Mash the yolks into the warm sauce until smooth, then mix in 1 tablespoon mayo and half the bacon.
Fill the egg whites with the yolk mixture, pressing it in lightly.
Stir the remaining mayo with a few drops of hot sauce, then top each egg with a small dab of it and the rest of the bacon.
recipes.note: Filled eggs keep a day or two in the fridge; add the spicy mayo and bacon right before serving. Nutrition is per egg half, about 2 halves per person.

recipes.name: Baked Shredded Brussels Sprout Salad with Smashed Potatoes

req.l: Dressing: 1/2 avocado, 1/3 cup plain yogurt, 1 garlic clove, zest of 1 lemon and juice of 1/2, 1 tsp capers, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tsp agave or maple, 1/4 cup water, 1 tsp dried dill

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line 3 small trays with parchment.
Boil the potatoes in well-salted water 12 minutes until tender; drain.
Smash the potatoes on an oiled tray, season with 1 tsp each oregano and garlic powder, 1/2 tsp coriander, salt and pepper, drizzle with 1 tbsp oil and bake 20 minutes. Flip and bake 10–15 more.
Dry the chickpeas, toss with 1/2 tbsp oil and salt and roast 20 minutes. Add 1/2 tsp each garlic powder and oregano and roast 10 more.
Toss half the sprouts with the shallots, remaining oil and spices and roast 15 minutes until crisp at the edges.
Blend the dressing ingredients until smooth, then stir in the dill.
Toss the raw sprouts and parsley with the roasted sprouts, top with the potatoes, drizzle with dressing and finish with the chickpeas.

recipes.name: Black Bean Hummus
steps: Blend everything in a food processor until almost smooth. Let sit 15 minutes before serving with iceberg lettuce wedges.

recipes.name: Red Wine Vinaigrette

req.l: 1/2 cup red wine or sherry vinegar
Optional: capers, cornichons, fresh herbs, red pepper flakes, citrus zest

steps: Combine the vinegar and garlic, season, and let sit 30 minutes. Discard the garlic.
Add the mustard and slowly whisk in the oil until emulsified. Fold in any optional additions.

recipes.name: Salmon, Potatoes & Brussels Sprouts

req.l: Salt and pepper; red pepper flakes (optional)

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Toss the potatoes with oil, salt and pepper and roast 35–40 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp.
Toss the sprouts with 3 tbsp oil, half the garlic, salt and pepper and roast 20–25 minutes on a single layer, shaking halfway. Add the Parmesan for the last 5 minutes.
Put the salmon on a lined sheet, drizzle with 2 tbsp oil, top with the remaining garlic, herbs, salt, pepper and lemon slices. Bake 12–15 minutes until it flakes.
Finish the sprouts with balsamic if you like.

recipes.name: Goodfellas Prison Sauce

req.l: 1/2 lb beef chuck, cut into 1-inch pieces

steps: Brown the beef and veal in batches in 1 tbsp oil in a heavy pot, 5–7 minutes per batch. Set aside.
Brown the sausage, breaking it up, about 5 minutes. Set aside with the beef.
Lower the heat, add the remaining oil and soften the onion 5 minutes. Add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Deglaze with the wine and simmer 2 minutes.
Stir in the broth, tomatoes and tomato paste and return the meats.
Simmer gently, partially covered, for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the basil 10–15 minutes before serving and season.

recipes.name: Vinaigrette
steps: Whisk the Dijon, vinegar, shallot and garlic, then slowly whisk in the oil. Add herbs and season.

recipes.name: Easier Tacos

req.l: 1 (15-oz) can black beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Mix the spices together and season the chicken.
Cook the chicken; when it's about 90% done, add the drained beans so they warm and take on the seasoning without going mushy.
Finish with a squeeze of lime and serve in tortillas.

recipes.name: Rhubarb Cake

req.l: Butter and demerara sugar for the pan, plus demerara for the top
1 stick (113 g) unsalted butter, melted and cooled

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Butter a 4 1/2 × 8 1/2-inch loaf pan, line with a parchment sling, butter it and coat with demerara sugar.
Trim 4–5 thin 8 1/2-inch rhubarb stalks (about 4 oz) for the top. Chop the rest into 1/2-inch pieces.
Cook two-thirds of the chopped rhubarb (8 oz) with 1 tbsp water, mashing, until it looks like applesauce, 5–7 minutes. Cool completely, then stir in the baking soda.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt. In another bowl whisk the sugar, butter, eggs and zest until thick, then whisk in the yogurt, vanilla and rhubarb mush.
Whisk wet into dry just until combined, then fold in the reserved chopped rhubarb.
Scrape into the pan, lay the stalks on top and sprinkle generously with demerara.
Bake 60 minutes, then lower to 325°F and bake until a tester comes out clean, 80–90 minutes total. Tent with foil if it darkens.
Cool 20 minutes in the pan, lift out and cool completely.
recipes.note: Keeps up to 5 days well wrapped at room temperature. Err on the side of overbaking; it's very moist.

recipes.name: Pistachio Pinwheels

req.l: 12 tbsp (170 g) unsalted butter, room temperature

steps: Pulse the pistachios until very finely ground; set aside.
In the food processor, cream the butter and powdered sugar, add the yolks and almond extract, then pulse in the flour and salt to a stiff dough.
Work the almond flour into two-thirds of the dough. Roll it between parchment into a 12 × 8-inch slab, 1/4 inch thick, and chill until firm, 10–15 minutes.
Pulse the ground pistachios into the remaining dough until green.
Spread the pistachio dough over the almond slab, leaving a 1/2-inch border on the long sides. Roll into a tight log, wrap and chill at least 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F. Roll the log firmly in demerara sugar, trim the ends and slice into 32 rounds.
Bake on two lined sheets 15–20 minutes until golden at the edges, rotating halfway. Cool on the sheets.
recipes.note: Keeps 5 days airtight or 2 months frozen. The unsliced log keeps 2 days refrigerated or 2 months frozen.

recipes.name: Blueberry Pop Tarts

req.l: Filling: 1 1/2 cups blueberries; 1/4 cup honey, maple or sugar; 1 tbsp lemon juice; 1–2 tsp lemon zest; 1 tbsp cornstarch; pinch of salt
Glaze (optional): 1/2 cup powdered sugar, 1–2 tbsp milk, 1/2 tsp vanilla

steps: Cook the blueberries, sweetener, lemon juice, zest and salt over medium until the berries burst, 3–5 minutes. Stir in the cornstarch mixed with 1–2 tsp water and simmer 1–2 minutes until jammy. Cool completely.
Whisk the flour, salt and sugar. Cut in the butter to pea-size pieces, add water a tablespoon at a time until it holds, form two discs and chill 30–60 minutes.
Heat the oven to 375°F. Roll each disc 1/8 inch thick and cut into 3 × 4-inch rectangles.
Spoon 1–1 1/2 tbsp filling onto half, brush the edges with egg, top, seal with a fork, poke vents and brush with egg.
Bake 22–26 minutes until golden. Glaze once cool if you like.
recipes.note: Keeps 2 days at room temperature, 5 in the fridge, or 3 months frozen unglazed. Reheat at 350°F.

recipes.name: Blueberry Slab Pie

req.l: 7 1/2 cups (975 g) all-purpose flour, plus more for rolling
6 sticks (680 g) unsalted butter, cubed and chilled
3 1/2 lb (1.6 kg) fresh or frozen blueberries
2 1/2 tsp ground ginger, 1 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1/2 tsp cardamom, 1/2 tsp salt

steps: Make the dough in two batches: pulse half the flour, sugar and salt, pulse in half the butter to hazelnut-size pieces, then drizzle in ice water until it holds when squeezed. Flatten each batch into a square, wrap and chill at least 2 hours.
Roll one block to about 18 × 15 inches and cut into 1 1/2-inch strips; chill.
Line the bottom oven rack with foil and preheat a second half-sheet pan on it at 425°F.
Toss the blueberries with the sugar, cornstarch, zest, juice, vanilla, spices and salt.
Roll the second block to 21 × 16 inches and fit it into an 18 × 13 half-sheet pan with a 1/2-inch overhang. Brush the border with egg and fill.
Lay the strips diagonally across the top, trim, fold the overhang over, brush with egg and sprinkle with demerara.
Bake nested in the hot pan 20 minutes, then at 350°F for 1 hour 15 minutes to 1 hour 30 minutes until deep golden and bubbling. Cool at least 1 hour.
recipes.note: Don't thaw frozen berries. Keeps 4 days covered at room temperature.

recipes.name: Raw Carrot Salad

req.l: 1 tbsp white or apple cider vinegar

steps: Whisk the vinegar, lime, mustard, honey and salt, then slowly whisk in the oil.
Shave the carrots into long ribbons with a peeler.
Toss with the sesame seeds and herbs, drizzle with dressing and serve with a lime wedge.

recipes.name: Blackened Salmon with Lentil Salad and Garlicky Kale

req.l: 1 tsp smoked paprika; 1/2 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, oregano; 1/4 tsp cayenne; 1/2 tsp salt
2 cups Lentil and Roasted Carrot Salad

steps: Coat the salmon with the spice mix.
Heat half the oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium-high and cook the salmon 3–4 minutes per side until the crust darkens and the center is just set.
In another pan, cook the garlic and chili flakes in the remaining oil 30 seconds, add the kale and a splash of water and cook 4 minutes until tender.
Serve with a cup of lentil salad each and lemon.
recipes.note: Turn on the hood fan; blackening gets smoky.

recipes.name: Spiced Black Bean & Edamame Power Bowl (3-Day Batch)

req.l: 2 1/4 cups canned black beans, rinsed and drained

steps: Whisk the lime juice, olive oil, cumin, garlic powder and salt. It should taste bright and punchy.
Toss the black beans with a third of the dressing while at room temperature.
Warm the edamame 2 minutes and pat dry.
Toss the cabbage with a pinch of salt and a squeeze of lime and let sit 5 minutes.
Divide the cabbage among 3 containers, add the beans and edamame, and drizzle with the remaining dressing.
To serve, add half an avocado, the cotija, cilantro and a last squeeze of lime. Eat cold.
recipes.note: Keeps 4–5 days and improves on day 2. Add a fried egg for about 6g more protein. Feta works in place of cotija.

recipes.name: Marinated Sun-dried Tomato Bean Salad

req.l: 1 (15-oz) can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
Toasted sourdough rubbed with garlic, to serve

steps: Soak the shallot in ice water 10 minutes, then drain and pat dry.
Mince half the parsley and whisk it with the mayo, oil, mustard, vinegar, caper brine, agave, oregano, pepper flakes, lemon zest and juice and a pinch of salt.
Add the beans, sun-dried tomatoes, scallions, capers, shallot, avocado, salt and pepper and stir well.
Chill at least 30 minutes. Serve with garlic-rubbed toast.

recipes.name: Açaí Bowl

req.l: 4 scoops vanilla or unflavored protein powder
4 tbsp natural peanut or almond butter

steps: Blend the açaí, 1 banana, frozen berries, yogurt, almond milk and protein powder until thick like soft-serve.
Divide among 4 bowls.
Top each with chia, nut butter, sliced banana, granola, almonds, coconut and berries.
recipes.note: To prep ahead, freeze the blended base and add toppings just before eating.

recipes.name: Go-to Guac
steps: Mash the avocados with the lime juice and salt, then fold in the cumin, cayenne, onion, jalapeño, tomatoes, cilantro and garlic.

recipes.name: Lentil & Spinach Stew with Olive Oil Finish

req.l: 150 g cooked brown or green lentils

steps: Sauté the onion in 5 g olive oil over medium heat 5–6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin and oregano and cook 30 seconds.
Add the lentils and broth and simmer gently 10–15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until just wilted, then finish with the remaining olive oil, lemon, salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Carrot Coffee Cake

req.l: 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp nutmeg, 1/4 tsp ground ginger
1/2 cup sour cream or plain Greek yogurt
Crumble: 1/4 cup flour, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 2 tbsp melted butter

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease an 8 × 8 pan.
Mix the crumble ingredients until crumbly.
Whisk the flour, leaveners, salt and spices. Beat the butter and sugars until fluffy, add the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Add the dry ingredients in two batches alternating with the sour cream, then fold in the carrots.
Spread in the pan, top with the crumble and bake 30–35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.name: Saffron Risotto

req.l: 4 tbsp cold unsalted butter, in chunks

steps: Warm half the stock with the saffron at a low simmer.
Soften the onion in the oil over medium-low, about 5 minutes. Add the rice and toast over medium-high 3–4 minutes.
Add the wine and stir until absorbed.

Add the saffron stock a ladle or two at a time, stirring as each is absorbed, then continue with the remaining stock until the rice is tender but not mushy and loose enough to cover the bottom of a bowl.
Beat in the butter and cheese vigorously, season with salt and serve immediately.
recipes.note: You can half-cook it, spread it out to cool, and finish it when guests arrive. Keep it soupy, not stiff.

recipes.name: Reese's Eggs

req.l: 1 1/2 cups creamy or crunchy peanut butter
22 oz milk chocolate chips (two 11-oz bags, divided)

steps: Beat the powdered sugar, peanut butter and melted butter together; it will be crumbly until you add the milk and keep beating until soft.
Working with 1-2 cups at a time, roll the dough about 1/2 inch thick on a floured surface and cut egg shapes with an oval cutter.
Arrange the eggs on a baking sheet and freeze at least 1 hour.
Microwave one bag of chocolate chips with 1 tablespoon shortening until melted, thinning with a bit more shortening if needed.
Fully dip each frozen egg in chocolate and let it set on wax paper.
Melt the second bag with more shortening when you run low.
recipes.note: You need an oval or egg-shaped cookie cutter, about 2 1/2 inches long. Store airtight in the fridge or freezer and let frozen eggs sit about 15 minutes before eating.

recipes.name: Shrimp Sushi Stacks

req.l: Wonton or tortilla strips and sesame seeds, to garnish
Guacamole: 2 avocados, 1 tbsp lime juice, 2 small garlic cloves, 1/4 tsp salt
Mango salsa: 2 large mangos, 1 red pepper, 1/2 red onion (all diced), 2 tbsp cilantro, 1 tbsp lime juice, 1/4 tsp salt
Sushi rice: 1/2 cup sticky rice, 3/4 cup water, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp rice vinegar

steps: Cook the sticky rice per the package, then season with the vinegar and salt.
Mix the guacamole and the mango salsa.
In a 2-cup measuring cup (or 1-cup for appetizers), layer mango salsa, guacamole, shrimp, nori strips and rice. Press down hard.
Run a knife around the edge and tap out onto a plate.
Top with wonton strips, bang bang sauce and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Homemade Cranberry Sauce
steps: Combine everything except the vanilla and pecans in a saucepan.
Bring to a gentle boil, then simmer 10–12 minutes until the berries burst and it thickens.
Off the heat, stir in the vanilla and pecans. Cool, remove the cinnamon stick and serve.
recipes.note: Make up to 5 days ahead. Blend for a smooth sauce.

recipes.name: Sour Cherry Pie

req.l: 2 recipes flaky all-butter pie dough (almond variation)
1/2 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp cardamom, 1/4 tsp kosher salt

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F with a rack in the lowest position.
Roll one dough to a 13-inch round, fit into a 9-inch pie plate with a 3/4-inch overhang and chill. Roll the second and cut into 1-inch strips; chill.
Toss the cherries with the sugar, cornstarch, zest, vanilla, spices, salt and almond extract.
Fill the crust, brush the edge with egg, and weave a lattice. Trim, fold the overhang in, crimp, brush with egg and sprinkle with demerara.
Bake on a foil-lined sheet 20 minutes, then at 350°F for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until bubbling in the center, tenting as needed.
Cool completely, at least 4 hours.
recipes.note: Freeze pitted cherries even if baking right away; they keep the pastry cold. Don't pull the pie until the center bubbles.

recipes.name: Salmon Bowl

req.l: 2 tbsp Japanese mayo + 2 tbsp sriracha (spicy mayo)
1 lb skinless salmon, in 1 to 1 1/2-inch pieces
Slaw dressing: 2 tbsp tamari, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp grated ginger, 1 tsp grated garlic
Topping: 1 tsp sesame oil, 1/2 cup panko, 1/4 tsp each garlic and onion powder

steps: Mix the spicy mayo and chill.
Combine the soy, vinegar, sesame oil, sriracha and green onion whites; marinate the salmon 30–40 minutes.
Meanwhile cook the rice, toss the cabbage and green onion greens with the slaw dressing, and toast the panko with the sesame oil and spices until golden.
Roast the salmon on an oiled foil-lined pan at 400°F for 6–8 minutes, then broil about 1 minute until crisp.
Build bowls: 1/2 cup rice, slaw, salmon, avocado and cucumber. Top with nori, sesame seeds, panko and spicy mayo.

recipes.name: French Onion Baked Lentils and Farro

req.l: 2 lb (910 g) yellow onions (4 large or 5 medium), sliced
2 tbsp (30 ml) dry sherry, vermouth, or white wine (optional)
3/4 cup (135 g) dried lentils (green/le puy or brown/italian preferred)
6 cups (1.4 L) vegetable broth, plus extra splashes if needed

steps: Melt the butter with the oil in a large deep pan, ovenproof if possible, add the onions, cover and let them sweat on low for 15-20 minutes.
Uncover, raise the heat, salt well (about 2 tsp kosher salt) and cook, stirring often, about 20 minutes more until deep brown and jammy, lowering the heat once the liquid is gone.
Heat the oven to 375F (190C).
Stir in the garlic for a minute, then add the sherry or wine if using and cook it off.
Toast the farro in the pan for 2 minutes, then add the lentils, broth and thyme, bring to a simmer and season with salt and pepper; move to a baking dish if the pan isn't ovenproof.
Cover and bake 40-50 minutes, stirring once halfway, until the grains and lentils are tender, adding 1/4-1/2 cup more broth if it dries out; it should stay loose like risotto.
Pull out the thyme stems, cover the top with Gruyère and broil until browned.
recipes.note: Keeps 4-5 days in the fridge; reheat at 350F. The base can be made a few days ahead, loosened with broth when reheated, and topped with cheese and broiled just before serving.

recipes.name: Tuscan Orzo Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F.
In a large baking dish, mix the chicken with the seasonings and garlic, then the sun-dried tomatoes and spinach.
Make a well in the center and add the Boursin.
Add the lemon juice, broth and water and stir around the cheese. Add the orzo and press it under the liquid.
Bake 30 minutes, stir the cheese through, and rest 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
steps: Soak the onion in cold water 10 minutes, then drain.
Whisk the oil, lemon, oregano, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the chickpeas, peppers, onion and parsley and toss.
Fold in the feta just before serving or packing.
recipes.note: Keeps 4–5 days. For a lunch, top a cup with 2 hard-boiled eggs. Nutrition is per cup.

recipes.name: Lentil and Roasted Carrot Salad

req.l: 1 cup dry green or black lentils

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the carrots with 1 tbsp oil, cumin and salt and roast 25 minutes until caramelized.
Simmer the lentils in salted water 20–25 minutes until tender. Drain.
Whisk the remaining oil, lemon, mustard, salt and pepper and toss with the warm lentils.
Fold in the carrots, parsley and feta.
recipes.note: Dressing the lentils warm seasons them all the way through. Nutrition is per cup.

recipes.name: Lasagna
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Brown the beef in a large pot in one piece, then break into chunks. Add the basil, oregano, 2 tsp salt, pepper flakes and fennel and toast until fragrant. Drain and add the marinara.
Mix the ricotta with the egg and 1/2 tsp salt.
Coat the noodles in the sauce. Spread 1 1/2 cups sauce in a 9 × 13 pan and add a layer of noodles.
Layer a third of the provolone, 1 1/2 cups sauce, a quarter of the mozzarella and Parmesan, and a third of the ricotta. Repeat.
Finish with noodles, then the remaining Parmesan and mozzarella. Cover with foil.
Bake 40 minutes, uncover and bake 10 more. Rest 20–25 minutes and garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Savory Cottage Cheese Bowl

req.l: Black pepper and a few drops of olive oil

steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with the radishes, scallion, seasoning, pepper and oil.
Serve with the toast.
recipes.note: Swap the radishes for shaved fennel or cucumber.

recipes.name: Poppy Seed Almond Cake

req.l: Neutral oil and flour, for the pan
Glaze: 3/4 cup powdered sugar, 1/4 cup orange juice, 2 tsp melted butter, 1/2 tsp vanilla, 1/2 tsp almond extract

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Oil and flour a 12-cup Bundt pan thoroughly.
Mix the sugar, poppy seeds, baking powder, salt and flour in a mixer.
Add the milk, oil, eggs and extracts, mix on low, then beat on medium-high 2 minutes until smooth and thick.
Bake 80–90 minutes until deep golden and a tester comes out clean. Cool 15 minutes, then invert onto a rack.
Poke holes all over the top. Whisk the glaze and brush it all over, re-brushing the drips. Cool completely.
recipes.note: Keeps 5 days wrapped. Two loaf pans work too, 75–80 minutes.

recipes.name: Greek Turkey Meatballs with Orzo and Chard
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Mix the turkey, egg, panko, feta, garlic, oregano, herbs, zest and salt and roll into 12 meatballs.
Bake on a lined sheet 15–18 minutes to 165°F, roasting the carrots alongside.
Cook the orzo in salted water 8–9 minutes and drain.
Sauté the chard in the oil with a pinch of salt 3–4 minutes.
Serve the meatballs with 1/2 cup orzo each, chard, carrots and tzatziki.
recipes.note: Double the meatballs and freeze half.

recipes.name: Breakfast Casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease a 9 × 13 dish.
Brown the sausage (with onion and pepper if using) and drain.
Layer the potatoes, then the sausage, then the cheese.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt, pepper and garlic powder and pour over.
Bake uncovered 40–45 minutes until set. Rest 5–10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Maple-Glazed Chickpea Bowl with Garlic Tahini Yogurt

req.l: 20 oz canned chickpeas, drained, rinsed and very dry
5/8 tsp ground coriander, 1/3 tsp fennel seeds, 5/8 tsp smoked paprika
2 5/8 tsp soy sauce or coconut aminos
1 1/3 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil and 1 1/3 tsp za'atar, to finish

steps: Cook the farro in salted water 25–30 minutes and drain.
Whisk a glaze of half the garlic, half the lemon juice and zest, the soy sauce, 2 tbsp maple and the hot sauce.
Sear the very dry chickpeas in the avocado oil over medium-high, undisturbed 3 minutes, toss, then 2 more.
Add the shallot and a pinch of salt for 2 minutes, then bloom the coriander, fennel and paprika 1 minute.
Lower the heat, add the glaze and reduce until sticky, 2–3 minutes. Stir in the parsley.
Whisk the tahini, yogurt, remaining maple, garlic, lemon and water into a thick, pourable sauce.
Build bowls: farro, arugula, cucumber, tomatoes, chickpeas and pickled onion. Drizzle with sauce and finish with feta, olive oil and za'atar.
recipes.note: About 18–20g protein per bowl; add a soft-boiled egg or 3 oz chicken or salmon to push it higher. For a lighter bowl, halve the farro and double the greens. Farro, chickpeas and sauce all keep; assemble fresh.

recipes.name: Chicken Meatballs in Tomato Sauce

req.l: 1 tsp dried oregano, plus 2 g for the sauce

steps: Gently mix the chicken, egg, almond flour, Parmesan, half the garlic, parsley, oregano, salt and pepper. Form 16–18 meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in 10 g oil over medium heat 6–8 minutes; set aside.
In the same pan, soften the onion in the remaining oil 5–6 minutes, add the remaining garlic for 30 seconds, then the tomatoes, paste, herbs, salt and pepper.
Return the meatballs, cover and simmer 20–25 minutes, turning once.

recipes.name: Black Bean Taquitos with Salsa Roja

req.l: Salsa: 2–3 tsp avocado oil, 4 plum tomatoes, 4–6 dried chiles de árbol, 3 cloves garlic, 1/2 small white onion, 1/2 tsp vegetable bouillon, 2 tsp white wine vinegar, 3 sprigs cilantro, salt
1 tbsp avocado oil, plus more for baking
1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp ground coriander, 1/4 tsp ground cumin
1/2 cup low-sodium vegetable broth or water
Pico de gallo, crema and shredded lettuce, to serve

steps: Char the halved tomatoes and onion cut-side down 3–4 minutes per side, add the garlic for 2–3 minutes, then toast the chiles 10 seconds per side. Cool, stem the chiles, and blend everything with the vinegar, bouillon and salt.
Heat the oven to 425°F and oil a tray.
Soften the onion in the oil, add the garlic, then the spices. Add the beans, 1/3 cup salsa and the broth and heat 5 minutes. Mash lightly and cool.
Warm the tortillas, fill each with 2–3 tbsp filling, roll and place seam-side down. Brush with oil.
Bake on the bottom rack 15 minutes, flip and bake 8–10 more on the middle rack.
Serve with crema, lettuce, pico and extra salsa.

recipes.name: Toasted S'mores Martini

req.l: Graham cracker rim and toasted marshmallow (optional)

steps: Shake everything with ice and strain into a graham-rimmed martini glass.

recipes.name: Sheet Pan Pizza
steps: Coat an 18 × 13 sheet pan with 1/4 cup olive oil.
Proof the yeast and sugar in the warm water 10 minutes in a stand mixer.
Add the flour and garlic salt, mix on low, then slowly add the remaining oil and knead until smooth, about 5 minutes.
Press the dough into the pan, cover and let rise 30 minutes. Heat the oven to 450°F.
Press the dough out again, spread with sauce, add half the cheese, the pepperoni, the rest of the cheese and Italian seasoning.
Bake 20–25 minutes until browned and bubbling. Rest 5–10 minutes before cutting.

recipes.name: Chili Cheese Étouffée

req.l: 1 cup chopped green onions, plus more to garnish
1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1 tsp dried basil
1/4 tsp each black, white and cayenne pepper
1 tsp chili powder; pinch each coriander, cumin, cloves

steps: Make a golden roux: melt the butter, whisk in the flour and cook, stirring constantly, about 30 minutes.
Cook the rice.
Add the green onions, celery, peppers, onions, garlic and tomatoes to the roux and cook until the onions brown.
Add the thyme, tomato paste, basil and peppers, then the stock. Boil, then simmer uncovered until thick.
Stir in the cheese, half-and-half, chili powder, spices, Worcestershire and Tabasco until smooth.
Fold in the crawfish and serve over rice with green onions and a drizzle of sherry.

recipes.name: Shrimp, White Bean & Arugula Skillet

req.l: 170 g raw shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: Pat the shrimp very dry and season lightly.
Warm the oil over medium, add the garlic and pepper flakes for 30–45 seconds without browning.
Add the shrimp in a single layer and cook 1 1/2–2 minutes per side.
Lower the heat, add the beans and a pinch of salt and warm 2–3 minutes.
Off the heat, toss in the arugula, lemon juice and zest until just wilted.

recipes.name: Universal Stock

req.l: 4 sprigs thyme, 4 sprigs parsley, 3 bay leaves

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and oil 2 roasting pans.
Toss the bones with the tomato paste and flour and roast about 60 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned. Roast the vegetables in the other pan about 30 minutes.
Transfer the bones and vegetables (not the fat) to a large stockpot, cover with cold water, add the herbs and peppercorns and bring to a high simmer without boiling.
Simmer 6–10 hours, skimming foam and fat. Don't stir.
Remove the bones and strain a few times until clear.
recipes.note: Makes about 6 quarts. Keeps 4 days refrigerated or 3 months frozen.

recipes.name: Hot Honey Glazed Carrots

req.l: 2 tbsp olive oil or melted butter
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar or lemon juice

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a sheet with parchment.
Toss the carrots with the oil, salt and pepper and roast 20–25 minutes, flipping halfway.
Whisk the honeys, vinegar and paprika, drizzle over the carrots and roast 5 more minutes.
Finish with herbs and an extra drizzle of hot honey.

recipes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup

req.l: 1/2 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp dried rosemary, 2 bay leaves

steps: Season the chicken and place it in a 6-quart slow cooker with the stock, vegetables, garlic and herbs. Cook on LOW 6–8 hours.
Shred the chicken and return it with the pasta. Cook on LOW 30–40 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the lemon juice and parsley and season.

recipes.name: Tomato Orzo Soup with Chicken Meatballs

req.l: Handful of fresh parsley, finely chopped

steps: Mix the chicken, half the garlic, parsley, 3/4 tsp salt and pepper and form 25 mini meatballs.
Brown the meatballs in a sprayed pot over medium-high; set aside.
Add the oil, onion, carrot, pepper and remaining garlic and cook until softened, about 6 minutes. Add the herbs, paprika, cayenne, salt and pepper.
Add the tomatoes, breaking them up, then the paste and stock. Boil, cover and simmer 10 minutes, then stir in the sugar.
Add the meatballs, orzo and cream cheese and simmer uncovered 12–15 minutes until the orzo is cooked and the soup is creamy.
recipes.note: Freezes well. Top with a little Parmesan if you like.

recipes.name: Classic Deviled Eggs
steps: Lower the eggs into water that has just stopped boiling, return to high heat and cook 14 minutes.
Transfer to an ice bath until completely cool, then peel and halve.
Mash the yolks with the mayo, mustard, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Spoon back into the whites and sprinkle with paprika.

recipes.name: Hominy Grits

req.l: 1/2 tbsp garlic powder, 1/2 tbsp onion powder

steps: Whisk the cornstarch into the water.
Bring the coconut milk, nutritional yeast, spices, salt and lemon to a boil, add the slurry and simmer 5 minutes, stirring.
Add the hominy and heat 5 more minutes.
Char the serranos in a skillet until blackened and serve on top.

recipes.name: Cuban Picadillo

req.l: 400 g fresh tomatoes, peeled and chopped

steps: Brown the beef with the onion, garlic and 1 tsp salt.
Add the tomatoes and cook until they start to break down.
Stir in the potatoes, cumin, oregano, pepper flakes and chili powder.
Add the pepper, olives, raisins, tomato paste, balsamic and stock.
Boil, then simmer 15–20 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the liquid has reduced. Season and top with cilantro.

recipes.name: White Bean and Pesto Bake

req.l: 1 (15-oz) can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
1/3 cup pesto, plus more to serve

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and bring the broth to a boil.
Combine the rice, beans, pesto, salt and tomatoes in an 8 × 8 dish, pour over the hot broth and stir.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 65–75 minutes. Uncover and bake 5–10 more if liquid remains.
Top with panko and Parmesan and broil until golden. Add more pesto if you like.

recipes.name: Salmon over Warm Lentils with Roasted Beets

req.l: 3 medium beets, peeled and cut in wedges

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the beets with 1 tsp oil and salt and roast 35–40 minutes. (Roast them ahead to save time.)
Simmer the lentils in salted water 20–25 minutes, drain, and toss with the vinegar, Dijon, 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper.
Season the salmon and sear skin-side down in the remaining oil over medium-high 4 minutes, then flip for 2–3.
Plate the lentils, then the arugula, beets, feta and salmon.
recipes.note: Golden beets won't stain everything pink.

recipes.name: Mixed Fruit Chutney

req.l: 1 Granny Smith apple, peeled and grated
1 tbsp grated lemon or lime zest

steps: Soak the figs, apricots and raisins in hot water about 1 hour; drain.
Combine everything in a heavy saucepan, boil, then simmer, stirring often, about 15 minutes until thick and sticky. Add a splash of water if dry.
Chill uncovered. Keeps 2 weeks refrigerated.

recipes.name: Cucumber Salad
steps: Mix the garlic, sugar, sesame seeds and green onion, then add the vinegar, soy and oils.
Slice the cucumbers thin (or spiralize), salt them and let sit 8–12 minutes.
Rinse, pat dry, and toss with the dressing. Top with sesame seeds and green onions.

recipes.name: Black Bean Soup

req.l: 660 g cooked black beans (2 cans, drained)
1 tbsp lime juice or sherry vinegar
Greek yogurt or sour cream, to garnish (optional)

steps: Sauté the onion, celery and carrot in the oil 8–10 minutes until caramelized. Salt lightly.
Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the beans, broth, water and soy sauce. Boil, then simmer 10–15 minutes.
Partially blend with an immersion blender for a thick, creamy texture.
Stir in the lime juice and season. Top with yogurt, cilantro or pickled onions.
