recipes.name: Turkey Kofta with Roasted Cauliflower

req.l: 1/4 cup parsley, chopped, plus 1 cup for the salad
1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1/2 tsp cinnamon
Parsley salad: parsley, mint, lemon, olive oil, salt

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the cauliflower with the oil and salt and roast 25 minutes.
Mix the turkey, onion, garlic, 1/4 cup parsley, spices and salt and shape into 8 oval logs.
Roast the kofta next to the cauliflower 15–18 minutes to 165°F, or grill.
Toss the parsley and mint with lemon, oil and salt.
Serve the kofta with cauliflower, tzatziki and the herb salad.

recipes.name: Stuffed Peppers

req.l: 1 lb ground chicken or turkey (93% lean)
1 (15-oz) can black beans, drained and rinsed
1 1/2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1/2 tsp smoked paprika
3/4 cup shredded Mexican blend or sharp cheddar
2 tbsp cilantro or scallions, to garnish

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and grease a baking dish.
Cut the tops off the peppers, remove the seeds and stand them upright, trimming the bottoms if needed.
Soften the onion in the oil 4–5 minutes, then add the garlic for 60 seconds.
Add the meat and cook over medium-high 6–7 minutes, letting it brown before stirring.
Add the spices, salt and pepper, then the tomatoes for 2 minutes. Off the heat, fold in the farro and beans.
Pack the filling into the peppers and top with cheese. Add 1/4 cup water to the dish, cover with foil and bake 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake 10 more minutes. Rest 5 minutes and garnish.
recipes.note: Make the filling ahead and bake fresh; stuffed peppers keep 4 days. For a heartier plate, serve over more farro. Swap 1 tbsp gochujang for the chili powder for a Korean-style version.

recipes.name: Chicken and Black Bean Bowl

req.l: 12 oz grilled cumin-lime chicken breast, sliced (see first step)
1 can black beans, rinsed and warmed with cumin and salt

steps: For the chicken: marinate 1 1/2 lb breast in 1 tbsp oil, juice of 2 limes, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder and 1 tsp salt; grill or sear 5–6 minutes per side to 165°F.
Warm the chicken, rice and beans.
Build each bowl with 1/2 cup rice, 1/2 cup beans, 6 oz chicken, peppers, cabbage, 2 tbsp guacamole and salsa.
recipes.note: Save the extra grilled chicken for souvlaki.

recipes.name: Sunday Gravy

req.l: 2 lb sweet or hot pork sausage links
2 sprigs thyme or rosemary and 1 sprig basil, tied in cheesecloth

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Season the oxtail and brown it and the neck bones in batches in the oil in a Dutch oven; set aside. Brown the sausages and set aside.
Cook the onion in the pot, scraping up the browned bits. Add the garlic for 1 minute, then the tomato paste, oregano and pepper flakes until the paste darkens.
Deglaze with the wine and reduce by half. Add the stock, tomatoes, bay leaves and herb bundle, return the oxtail and bones, season and bring to a boil.
Cover and braise in the oven about 2 1/2 hours. Add the sausages and braise 30 minutes more.
Discard the herbs. Cook the rigatoni al dente, dry it briefly in the hot pot, and toss with enough sauce to coat.
Serve the pasta and sausages with extra sauce and grated cheese.

recipes.name: Caprese Triscuits
steps: Top each Triscuit with tomato, mozzarella and basil and drizzle with balsamic.

recipes.name: Dragon Lily

req.l: Gastrique: 12 oz agave nectar, 4 oz champagne vinegar, 1/4 cup tarragon leaves

steps: For the gastrique, boil the agave, slowly stir in the vinegar and boil 5 minutes. Off the heat, add the lightly muddled tarragon, cool and strain. Keeps 3 weeks refrigerated.
Stir the tequila, gastrique and bitters over ice, strain into a flute and top with champagne.

recipes.name: Biscuits

req.l: 8 tbsp frozen unsalted butter, plus 1 tbsp melted
2 cups all-purpose flour, plus more for kneading

steps: Heat the oven to 450°F and line a sheet pan.
Cube the frozen butter and keep it cold.
Whisk the dry ingredients, cut in the butter to coarse crumbs with pea-size lumps, then stir in the buttermilk with as few strokes as possible.
Knead gently 5–10 times, press to 3/4 inch thick and cut into squares.
Brush with melted butter and bake 10–12 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Cheesy Potato & Red Onion Croquettes

req.l: 2 lb Russet or Yukon Gold potatoes
1/2–1 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp black pepper, 1/2 tsp smoked paprika

steps: Boil the peeled, chopped potatoes in salted water until very tender, 12–15 minutes. Drain, let the steam escape, and mash.
Sauté the onion in the butter 5–8 minutes until lightly caramelized, adding the garlic at the end.
Mix the potatoes, onion, cheese and seasonings and chill 15–20 minutes.
Roll 2-tbsp portions into logs and coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Air fry at 400°F for 10–15 minutes or bake at 425°F for 15–20 minutes, flipping halfway.
recipes.note: Freeze breaded croquettes on a tray, then bag them; they keep 3 months and cook from frozen.

recipes.name: Lion's Tail
steps: Shake everything with ice until well chilled and strain into a coupe.
Express an orange twist over the top and discard it.

recipes.name: Brown Sugar Cinnamon Pop Tarts

req.l: Filling: 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1 tbsp flour, 2 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp salt, 2 tbsp softened butter, 1 tbsp maple syrup (optional)
Glaze (optional): 1/2 cup powdered sugar, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 2–3 tbsp milk, 1/2 tsp vanilla, pinch of cinnamon

steps: Mix the dough by hand: whisk the flour, sugar and salt, cut in the butter to pea-size pieces, add water until it clumps, form two discs and chill 30–60 minutes.
Mash the filling ingredients into a spreadable paste.
Heat the oven to 375°F. Roll each disc 1/8 inch thick and cut into 3 × 4-inch rectangles.
Spread 1–1 1/2 tbsp filling on half, brush the edges with egg, top, crimp, vent and brush with egg.
Bake 22–26 minutes until light golden. Glaze once cool.
recipes.note: Keeps 2 days at room temperature or 3 months frozen unglazed.

recipes.name: Turkey and Black Bean Chili

req.l: 3 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp oregano

steps: Brown the turkey in the oil over medium-high, about 8 minutes.
Add the onion, carrots and peppers for 6 minutes, then the garlic, spices and tomato paste for 2.
Add the tomatoes, beans and broth and simmer partly covered 30 minutes.
Stir in the vinegar, season, and portion into 1 1/2-cup containers. Freeze half.
recipes.note: Top with Greek yogurt instead of sour cream. Nutrition is per 1 1/2 cups.

recipes.name: Kale White Bean Salad

req.l: 1 (15-oz) can white beans, drained and rinsed
Dressing: 1/4 cup olive oil, 1/4 cup maple syrup, 1/4 cup lemon juice, 1/4 cup Dijon and grainy mustard, 1–2 garlic cloves, pinch of sea salt

steps: Stem and chop the kale and wash it.
Toss the seeds with a little oil and salt and broil 2–3 minutes, toss, then 1–2 more. Don't let them burn.
Blend the dressing with an immersion blender until creamy.
Toss the kale, beans, avocado, seeds and hemp hearts with the dressing.

recipes.name: Meyer Lemon Tart

req.l: 1 sweet tart crust, parbaked in a 9-inch tart pan

steps: Whisk the curd and yogurt until smooth and let come to room temperature.
Heat the oven to 350°F. Spread the jam over the crust and bake 5–7 minutes until set.
Fill the hot crust with the curd to the top and smooth it.
Bake 28–33 minutes until set at the edges with a gentle wobble in the center.
Cool completely, then chill at least 1 hour.
recipes.note: Keeps 3 days refrigerated but is best the day it's made.

recipes.name: Chewy Pumpkin Spice Cookies

req.l: 1 1/2 tsp cinnamon, 3/4 tsp allspice, 1/4 tsp cloves, 1/4 tsp ginger

steps: Brown the butter until nutty, then cool 30 minutes.
Stir the butter with both sugars, then the egg, vanilla, molasses and pumpkin.
Add the dry ingredients and stir until the dough comes together.
Scoop 28 g balls, roll smooth, cover and chill at least 2 hours.
Heat the oven to 350°F. Roll the balls in cinnamon sugar and bake 10–12 minutes until dry on top but moist in the cracks.

recipes.name: Kimchi Fried Rice

req.l: 1 cup kimchi, cut into thumbnail size pieces
150 g bacon (5.3 ounces), cut into thumbnail size pieces
3 cups steamed short grain rice (or medium grain rice)
4 x-large eggs, cooked sunny side up or per your preference
Optional: 1 pack enoki mushrooms (200 g / 7 ounces), root removed, rinsed and drained
Garnish: 1/2 stalk green onion, thinly sliced

steps: Heat a wok or pan over medium-high, add the cooking oil and stir the garlic for about 10 seconds.
Add the bacon and cook until roughly half done.
Add the kimchi and cook until mostly done.
If using enoki, toss them in for a few seconds, then drop the heat to medium-low.
Add the rice and kimchi juice and mix until evenly coated.
Stir in the sesame oil and take the pan off the heat.
Plate, garnish, and top each serving with an egg.
recipes.note: Use day-old, drier rice so it doesn't go gluey, and kimchi that's at least 2 weeks old (or add 1/2 tsp rice vinegar to the juice). Short on kimchi juice? Use 2 1/2 Tbsp juice plus 1 Tbsp gochujang.

recipes.name: Three-Bean Salad

req.l: 1 can cut green beans, drained (or 2 cups fresh, blanched)

steps: Whisk the vinegar, oil, mustard, honey, salt and pepper.
Toss with the beans, onion and parsley.
Chill at least 30 minutes; it's better overnight.
recipes.note: Serve with 2 eggs for a complete lunch. Nutrition is per cup.

recipes.name: Man o' War
steps: Shake with ice, strain and garnish with a lemon twist.

recipes.name: Tuna, White Bean & Olive Salad

req.l: 30 g red onion, very thinly sliced

steps: Flake the tuna in a bowl and add the beans, olives, tomatoes, onion and herbs.
Whisk the oil, lemon, Dijon, garlic, salt and pepper and toss gently.
Let sit 10–15 minutes before eating.

recipes.name: Berry Granola Breakfast Crumble
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F.
Toss the berries with the jam and cornstarch.
Stir the oats, protein powder, pecans, peanut butter, maple, vanilla, cinnamon and salt into small clumps.
Divide the berries among 2–3 ramekins, top with the crumble and bake on a tray 15–18 minutes until crisp.
Cool a few minutes and top with yogurt.

recipes.name: Strawberry Pop Tarts

req.l: Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar, 2–3 tbsp milk, 1/2 tsp vanilla, pink food coloring, rainbow sprinkles

steps: Pulse the flour, sugar and salt, pulse in the butter to coarse crumbs, then add ice water until it just comes together. Halve, wrap and chill 30 minutes.
Mix the preserves with the cornstarch and lemon juice.
Roll each half to 9 × 12 inches and cut nine 3 × 4-inch pieces. Add 1 tbsp filling to half, brush the edges with water, top, seal with a fork and vent.
Chill 15 minutes, then bake at 375°F for 20–25 minutes. Cool completely.
Spread with the glaze, add sprinkles and let set 1 hour.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter and Concord Grape Sandwich Cookies

req.l: 1 1/2 tsp kosher salt, plus more for the tops
2 sticks (227 g) unsalted butter, room temperature
1/2 cup (100 g) packed light brown sugar
1/2 cup (100 g) granulated sugar, plus more for the tops
1 cup (260 g) natural crunchy peanut butter
Concord grape jam: 1 lb Concord grapes, 1/2 cup sugar, 2 tbsp lemon juice (or 1 1/2 cups store-bought jam)

steps: For the jam, squeeze the grape flesh into a saucepan and keep the skins. Simmer the flesh 5–10 minutes until pulpy, then press through a sieve onto the skins to remove the seeds. Return to the pan with the sugar and lemon, boil to 220°F (15–20 minutes), and chill until set.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt.
Beat the butter and sugars until light, about 2 minutes, then the peanut butter until creamy. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the flour mixture and vanilla on low.
Roll the dough into two 2-inch logs, wrap and chill at least 2 hours.
Heat the oven to 350°F. Slice the logs into thin, even coins and space on lined sheets. Punch out the centers of half if making Linzers, and sprinkle those tops with sugar and a little salt.
Bake 13–15 minutes, rotating after 10. Cool completely.
Spread jam on the bottoms and press on the tops.
recipes.note: Best the day they're filled. Unfilled cookies keep 4 days; the jam keeps a month.

recipes.name: Green Goddess Salad

req.l: 1 small head green cabbage, finely chopped
Dressing: 1 cup basil, 1 cup spinach, 2 cloves garlic, 1 small shallot, juice of 2 lemons, 1/4 cup olive oil, 1/4 cup cashews or walnuts, 1/3 cup nutritional yeast, 1 tsp salt, 2 tbsp rice vinegar

steps: Finely chop the cabbage, cucumbers, chives and green onions.
Blend the dressing ingredients until smooth.
Toss the salad with the dressing.

recipes.name: Sesame Salmon with Farro & Garlic Edamame

req.l: 2 tbsp soy sauce, plus 1 tsp for the edamame
1 tbsp toasted sesame oil, plus 1/2 tsp
2 cups water or low-sodium chicken broth

steps: Simmer the farro in the water or broth with a pinch of salt, covered, 25–30 minutes until tender. Drain.
Whisk the soy, sesame oil, honey, vinegar, 2 garlic cloves and ginger.
Pat the salmon dry, salt it, and sear flesh-side down in the neutral oil over medium-high 3–4 minutes.
Flip, pour over the glaze and cook 3–4 minutes, spooning it over until lacquered. Rest 2 minutes.
Blister the edamame in 1 tsp oil 2–3 minutes, add the remaining garlic for 30 seconds, then toss with 1 tsp soy and 1/2 tsp sesame oil. Finish with chili flakes and flaky salt.
Serve the salmon over farro with the edamame, sesame seeds and scallions.
recipes.note: Add 1 tsp gochujang to the glaze for a spicy-sweet version. With batch-cooked farro this comes together in 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Unstuffed Cabbage Rolls

req.l: 1 tsp chili powder (optional), 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp paprika

steps: Cook the onion and beef in the oil over medium until the beef is no longer pink.
Add the garlic and spices for 30 seconds.
Stir in the rice, tomatoes, tomato sauce, broth, Worcestershire and cabbage and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the cabbage is tender. Add water if dry.

recipes.name: Shrimp Tacos with Apple-Cabbage Slaw

req.l: 1 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp salt
Slaw: 2 cups shredded cabbage, 1 apple in matchsticks, juice of 1 lime, 2 tbsp Greek yogurt, pinch of salt

steps: Toss the slaw ingredients together.
Season the shrimp and sear in the oil over high heat 1 1/2–2 minutes per side.
Char the tortillas and fill with shrimp and slaw. Finish with hot sauce and cilantro.
recipes.note: A tart apple like Granny Smith gives the slaw brightness.

recipes.name: Crispy Gochujang Rice Salad

req.l: Rice: 2 cups brown rice, cooked and cooled (or leftover)

steps: Heat the oven to 400F and stir together the gochujang, sesame oil and soy sauce, then toss the rice in it.
Spread the rice on a lined sheet pan and bake 15-20 minutes, stirring and respreading now and then, until crisp.
Whisk the dressing ingredients until smooth; it looks lumpy at first but comes together.
Combine the peas, cucumber, green onions, avocado and herbs in a bowl, add the crispy rice, drizzle with dressing and toss gently.
recipes.note: Day-old rice crisps best. To make ahead, store the crispy rice airtight on its own and combine with the salad at serving time.

recipes.name: Rice Pudding Cake with Mango Caramel

req.l: Caramel: 1 cup sugar, 1 1/2 cups chopped mango, 1/2 cup heavy cream, 4 tbsp unsalted butter, 1/2 tsp kosher salt
1 vanilla bean, seeds scraped, plus the pod
4 tbsp cold unsalted butter, plus more for the pan
1 large mango, thinly sliced, to serve

steps: For the caramel, cook the sugar with 1/3 cup water to deep amber, add the mango and cook 5 minutes, then stream in the cream and whisk in the butter and salt. Simmer 5–10 minutes, then blend smooth.
Simmer the rice, milks, salt, sugar, rum, cardamom and vanilla, stirring often, 25–30 minutes until the rice is translucent and floats in the thickened liquid.
Stir in the butter and cool until warm.
Heat the oven to 350°F and butter and line a 10-inch cake pan.
Beat the eggs and yolks into the rice mixture, pour into the pan and bake 40–50 minutes until a tester comes out clean. Cool completely.
Unmold and serve slices with caramel and fresh mango.
recipes.note: Caramel keeps 1 week; the cake keeps 3 days refrigerated.

recipes.name: Peach Cobbler Cinnamon Rolls

req.l: Peach jam: 1 1/2 cups (210 g) fresh ripe peaches, cubed
Peach jam: 2 tbsp (30 g) granulated sugar
Filling: 1/2 cup (60 g) very thinly sliced peaches
Dough: 1/2 cup (110 g) whole milk, room temperature
Dough: 1 (50 g) large egg, room temperature
Dough: 4 tbsp (56 g) unsalted butter, softened
Filling: 1/2 cup (113 g) unsalted butter, room temperature
Filling: 1/2 cup (100 g) light or dark brown sugar
Topping: 6 tbsp (84 g) unsalted butter, melted
Topping: 3/4 cup + 1 tbsp (100 g) all-purpose flour
Topping: 2 tbsp (25 g) light brown sugar, packed
Frosting: 4 tbsp (56 g) unsalted butter, room temperature
Frosting: 2 oz cream cheese, room temperature

steps: Cook the cubed peaches, sugar and lemon juice over medium heat until juicy and thick, stir in the cornstarch slurry, cook 2 minutes more and cool completely.
Whisk the tangzhong water and flour in a small pot over medium heat until it becomes a thick paste; set aside.
In a stand mixer combine the flour, sugar, yeast and salt, add the egg, milk, vanilla and tangzhong, and knead on low into a shaggy ball.
Add the softened butter a tablespoon at a time, then knead 10-11 minutes until smooth and elastic, adjusting with a little flour or milk if needed.
Shape into a ball, cover in a buttered bowl and let rise somewhere warm about 1 hour until doubled.
Line a 9x13 metal pan with parchment and beat the filling butter, brown sugar and cinnamon until smooth.
Roll the dough to an 18x15-inch rectangle, spread the brown sugar filling over it leaving a 1/2-inch bare strip along the far edge, then spread on the cooled jam and lay the thin peach slices across.
Cut 12 strips about 1 1/2 inches wide, roll each up and set them in the pan.
Cover and let rise about 60 minutes until doubled, heating the oven to 325F (162C) meanwhile.
Rub the topping ingredients together until crumbly and chill until needed.
Scatter the crumb over the rolls and bake 30-35 minutes until golden (center at least 190F), then cool on a rack.
Beat the cream cheese, butter and powdered sugar smooth, stir in the cream, and spoon over the warm rolls.
recipes.note: Leftovers keep airtight 3-5 days; reheat in the oven or microwave. Unbaked rolls freeze well: thaw overnight in the fridge and pick up at the second rise.

recipes.name: Chicken Caprese Bake

req.l: 1 tsp each dried oregano, basil and parsley
Fresh basil, balsamic glaze and Parmesan, to garnish

steps: Heat the oven to 500°F.
Soften the onion in the oil in an ovenproof skillet 5 minutes, then the garlic 1 minute.
Add the chicken and sausage and cook through, breaking it up. Drain if needed.
Season with the salt and herbs, then stir in the sauce and balsamic.
Scatter the mozzarella and tomatoes on top and bake 7–8 minutes until melted and blistered.
Garnish with basil, Parmesan and balsamic glaze.

recipes.name: Hillbilly Caviar

req.l: Dressing: 1/4 cup red wine vinegar, 1/4 cup olive oil, 1/4 cup chopped parsley, 1 1/2 tbsp fresh oregano (or 1 tsp dried), 1 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt
1 (15.5-oz) can white hominy, drained and rinsed
1 (15.5-oz) can black beans, drained and rinsed
1 (15.5-oz) can pinto beans, drained and rinsed
1 (15.5-oz) can black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed
Red pepper flakes or jalapeño, to taste

steps: Whisk the dressing, toss with everything else, and serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Greek Chicken Bowl

req.l: 5 g olive oil, 15 g lemon juice, 1 g dried oregano, 1 g garlic powder, salt and pepper
20 g red onion, very thinly sliced
10 g extra-virgin olive oil and 5 g red wine vinegar or lemon juice

steps: Pat the chicken dry and toss with the oil, lemon, oregano, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Grill or pan-sear over medium-high 5–6 minutes per side until cooked through. Rest 5 minutes and slice.
Toss the tomatoes, cucumber and onion with the oil, vinegar, salt, pepper and herbs.
Top the salad with the chicken and feta.

recipes.name: Smashed Beef Kebab with Cucumber Yogurt

req.l: 3 tbsp finely chopped mint, plus leaves to serve
1 lb ground beef (80% lean) or lamb
Warm pita or white rice, to serve

steps: Mix the yogurt, cucumber, chopped mint and garlic and chill.
Mix the beef, onion, turmeric, 1 tsp salt and lots of pepper.
Heat a cast-iron skillet until very hot, drop in large irregular chunks of beef and cook undisturbed 6–8 minutes until charred and crisp.
Toss, breaking up large pieces, add the walnuts and raisins and cook 2–3 minutes more.
Season the yogurt with the remaining salt, spread it on a platter and top with the meat. Finish with pomegranate molasses and mint. Serve with pita or rice.

recipes.name: Fresh Pasta Dough

req.l: 2 cups all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting

steps: Mound the flour, make a well, and add the eggs, yolks, oil and salt. Slowly work the flour in with a fork.
Knead 10–15 minutes until smooth (or use a stand mixer with a dough hook).
Wrap and chill at least 30 minutes, then let it come nearly to room temperature.
Cut into four and roll each through a pasta machine from widest to thinner settings, folding in thirds after the first passes.
Keep rolled sheets between parchment and cut into shapes.

recipes.name: Creamy Garlic Herb Mashed Potatoes

req.l: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened, plus 2 tbsp for topping

steps: Peel and cut the potatoes into 2-inch chunks. Cover with cold salted water with the garlic, boil, and simmer 15–20 minutes until tender.
Drain, return to the pot over low heat 1–2 minutes to dry, and mash with the garlic.
Mix in the butter and warm cream without overworking.
Fold in the sour cream and Parmesan and season.
Top with melted butter, chives and parsley.
recipes.note: Make up to 2 days ahead and reheat with a splash of cream.

recipes.name: Chicken and Sweet Potato Tacos

req.l: 1 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp salt
1 large sweet potato, cubed and roasted
Lime, cilantro, crumbled cotija or feta

steps: Season the chicken with the spices and salt.
Sear in the oil over medium-high 5–6 minutes per side to 165°F. Rest 5 minutes and slice.
Warm the sweet potato and char the tortillas.
Fill with chicken, sweet potato, cabbage and salsa verde, and finish with lime, cilantro and cheese.
recipes.note: Pound thick breasts to an even 3/4 inch so they cook evenly.

recipes.name: Chili

req.l: 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp cumin

steps: Lightly work the spices into the meat with a fork.
Sauté the onion in olive oil in an 8-quart pot 6–7 minutes, then add the garlic.
Add the meat and brown.
Add the chili beans, tomatoes and broth. Bring to a boil, then simmer.

recipes.name: Hot Honey Pepperoni Ricotta Pizza

req.l: Fresh basil and red pepper flakes (optional)

steps: Heat the oven to 500°F with a pizza stone or sheet inside for at least 30 minutes. Roll the dough to a 12-inch round.
Spread with sauce, top with mozzarella and pepperoni, and dollop with ricotta.
Bake 15–20 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Drizzle with hot honey and finish with basil and pepper flakes.

recipes.name: Lentil-Chickpea Stew with Spinach

req.l: 2 tsp ground cumin, 2 tsp paprika, 1/4 tsp ground allspice, 1/4 tsp ground turmeric
1/2 cup uncooked long-grain white or brown rice

steps: Cook the onions in the oil over medium, stirring occasionally, until deeply golden and jammy, 15–20 minutes.
Push the onions aside and toast the spices in the center 60 seconds.
Add the lentils, rice, water and bay leaves and bring to a boil.
Simmer partially covered 35–40 minutes with the salt and pepper until tender, adding water if it gets too thick.
Add the chickpeas and simmer 10 minutes.
Remove the bay leaves and wilt in the spinach. Season and serve with lemon or a drizzle of olive oil.
recipes.note: Caramelizing the onions is the flavor foundation. Freezes well; loosen leftovers with water.

recipes.name: Italian Ricotta Cookies

req.l: Glaze: 2 cups powdered sugar, 1 tbsp melted butter, 1 tsp vanilla, 3–4 tbsp milk

steps: Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt.
Beat the butter and sugar 1 minute, add the eggs one at a time, then the ricotta and vanilla.
Add the dry ingredients in two additions. Cover and chill at least 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 350°F. Scoop tablespoon portions 2 inches apart on lined sheets and bake 12–15 minutes until golden underneath. Cool.
Whisk the glaze to a drizzling consistency, dip the tops, add sprinkles and let set.

recipes.name: Spiced Apple Cider Donut Loaf

req.l: 1 tsp cinnamon, 1/2 tsp nutmeg, 1/2 tsp allspice
Crust: 1/4 cup sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon, 2 tbsp melted butter

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease and flour a 9 × 5 loaf pan.
Whisk the flour, leaveners, salt and spices.
Whisk the butter, sugars and eggs, then the cider and vanilla.
Stir the dry into the wet just until combined.
Bake 45–50 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Brush the warm loaf with melted butter and coat with cinnamon sugar.

recipes.name: Protein Oats

req.l: 1 scoop vanilla or unflavored protein powder

steps: Simmer the oats, milk, water, cinnamon and salt over medium 5 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in the grated fruit and cook 1 minute more.
Off the heat, cool a minute, then stir in the protein powder until smooth.
Top with the yogurt.
recipes.note: Prep four jars of dry oats, cinnamon and protein powder ahead to save time.

recipes.name: Cowboy Caviar

req.l: 240 g black beans, drained and rinsed
240 g black-eyed peas, drained and rinsed
120 g red bell pepper, finely diced
120 g green bell pepper, finely diced
Dressing: 30 g olive oil, 40 g lime juice, 15 g apple cider vinegar, 10 g honey, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/4 tsp pepper, 1/2 tsp garlic powder
Tortilla chips, about 28 g per serving

steps: Whisk the dressing.
Toss with everything except the avocado and chips. Add avocado as you serve, with chips for scooping.
recipes.note: Makes about 1 kg, 200 g per serving.

recipes.name: Pesto Risotto with Buttery Seared Scallops

req.l: 2 tbsp butter, plus 1 tbsp for basting
Pesto: 1/2 cup pine nuts, about 2 oz pecorino romano, 3 garlic cloves, 2 cups basil, about 1/2 cup olive oil, salt and pepper
Toasted pine nuts and cheese, to top

steps: Keep the broth warm on low.
Soften the onion in the oil and butter, add the rice and toast 2–3 minutes.
Add the wine and cook on low 3–4 minutes until absorbed.
Add a ladle of broth every 5–7 minutes as it dries, until it's all absorbed.
Blend the pesto and stir it in over low heat with a squeeze of lemon.
Heat a stainless pan until a drop of water glides, add the neutral oil and sear the scallops in batches 2 minutes per side, basting with butter in the last 30 seconds.
Serve the risotto with scallops, pine nuts and cheese.

recipes.name: Salted Halvah Blondies

req.l: 1/2 cup (100 g) packed light brown sugar

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line an 8 × 8 pan with buttered foil.
Whisk the flour, salt and baking powder.
Melt the white chocolate, butter and tahini over simmering water until smooth; cool slightly.
Whisk in the brown sugar, then the egg, yolks and vanilla vigorously until thick and glossy.
Stir in the dry ingredients, then gently fold in the halvah.
Spread in the pan, sprinkle with sesame seeds and flaky salt, and bake 20–25 minutes until golden at the edges and slightly jiggly in the center.
Cool completely, lift out with the foil and cut into 16.

recipes.name: Yogurt Bowl
steps: Toss the fruit with the cinnamon.
Top the yogurt with the fruit, granola and chia.
recipes.note: Add a drizzle of honey or a banana when you want more carbs.

recipes.name: Chicken Souvlaki Plate

req.l: 12 oz grilled chicken breast, sliced (or raw chicken marinated in lemon, oregano and garlic, grilled 6 min per side)

steps: Warm the chicken in a hot pan with a squeeze of lemon and the oregano.
Toss the tomatoes and onion with the oil, remaining lemon and salt.
Warm the pita.
Plate the chicken with the salad, 1/2 cup tzatziki and half a pita each.
recipes.note: Out of tomatoes? Use shredded cabbage and grated carrot dressed the same way.

recipes.name: Honey Pepper Chicken Mac and Cheese

req.l: 2 tsp freshly ground black pepper, divided

steps: Cook the macaroni al dente and drain.
Season the chicken with salt and 1 tsp pepper and cook in the oil until golden and cooked through, 6–8 minutes. Set aside.
Melt the butter in the same pan, add the garlic for 1 minute, then the honey and remaining pepper and simmer 2–3 minutes. Toss the chicken in the glaze.
Warm the cream gently and whisk in the cheeses until smooth. Season.
Fold in the macaroni, then the chicken. Garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Extra-Crispy Parmesan Roasted Potatoes

req.l: 3 lb russet potatoes, peeled, in 1 1/2- to 2-inch chunks
4 bay leaves, 1 tbsp black peppercorns, 6 garlic cloves, 3–4 thyme or rosemary sprigs (tied in cheesecloth)

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (400°F convection).
Cover the potatoes with 2 quarts water, the baking soda, salt and the aromatics bundle. Boil about 10 minutes until a knife slides in.
Drain, discard the bundle, and line a sheet pan with parchment.
Toss the potatoes with the butter and Parmesan until a starchy slurry coats them. Spread out on the pan.
Roast about 20 minutes, flip, and roast 15–20 more until crisp and deep gold. Cool 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Dark 'n' Bubbly

req.l: Syrup: 2 tbsp each black peppercorns, grains of paradise and coriander seeds; 1 1/2 cups demerara sugar; 1/2 cup superfine sugar; 2 cups hot water; 4 sprigs curry leaves

steps: For the syrup, toast the spices 2–3 minutes, add the sugars and water, boil, then simmer 2 minutes. Add the muddled curry leaves, cover 1 hour and strain.
Shake the rum, lime and syrup with ice, strain into a flute and top with champagne.

recipes.name: Mint and Basil Lemonade Mocktail

req.l: 1/2 c fresh basil leaves, plus extra sprigs for garnish
1/2 c fresh mint leaves, plus extra sprigs for garnish

steps: Muddle the basil and mint in a mortar and pestle or a small bowl.
Warm the honey with 1/2 cup of the water until just barely boiling, stirring to dissolve, then take off the heat.
Pour the warm syrup over the herbs and let it steep at room temperature for 30 minutes up to several hours.
Strain the herb syrup into a pitcher or quart jar.
Juice 8-10 lemons to get 1.5-2 cups.
Combine the syrup, lemon juice and remaining water in a large pitcher, add 2 cups ice and stir.
Serve over ice with a sprig of mint and basil.
recipes.note: Steep the syrup longer for more herb flavor. For a sparkling version, mix only the syrup and lemon juice as a base and top 1/3 cup of it with sparkling water over ice.

recipes.name: Chicken, Cauliflower and Chickpea Curry

req.l: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast or thighs, cubed
3 cloves garlic and 1 tbsp ginger, grated
2 tbsp curry paste (or 1 tbsp garam masala + 1 tsp turmeric)

steps: Cook the onion in the oil 6 minutes, then the garlic, ginger and curry paste 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk, cauliflower and chickpeas and simmer covered 15–18 minutes.
Wilt in the spinach and season with salt and lime.
Serve over 1/2 cup rice each.

recipes.name: Philly Cheesesteak Sloppy Joes

req.l: 1 1/2 tsp beef bouillon (Better than Bouillon works)
1 tsp each dried oregano and parsley; 1/2 tsp each salt, pepper, basil, paprika; 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Toast the split buns cut-side up 5 minutes.
Cook the beef, onion and pepper in the oil over medium-high about 7 minutes, then the garlic 30 seconds.
Whisk the broth, cornstarch and bouillon and add with the ketchup, Worcestershire, Dijon and seasonings. Simmer about 5 minutes until mostly absorbed.
Stir in the cheddar and season.
Spoon onto the bottom buns, top with provolone and bake 5–10 minutes until melted.
recipes.note: Filling keeps 5 days or freezes 3 months; ground turkey works with extra bouillon.

recipes.name: Hollandaise Sauce

req.l: 1/4 tsp salt, plus more to taste

steps: Melt the butter, skim the foam, and pour off the clear butter, leaving the milky solids. Keep warm.
Reduce the peppercorns, salt and vinegar until almost dry, then stir in the cold water.
Whisk with the yolks in a bowl over barely simmering water until pale, thick and creamy.
Off the heat, whisk in the butter a few drops at a time, then a ladle at a time, thinning with lemon if too thick.
Season, strain and serve within 90 minutes, kept warm.

recipes.name: Thai Peanut Sauce

req.l: 1/2 cup unsweetened coconut milk (from a can)

steps: Combine everything and blend until smooth with a whisk, food processor, or blender, or warm it all in a small saucepan just until the peanut butter melts.
Taste and adjust the seasoning.
Serve warm, chilled, or at room temperature.
recipes.note: Keeps up to 10 days refrigerated in an airtight container; it thickens when cold, so stir and warm it gently before using.

recipes.name: Chili Lime Chickpea and Cauliflower Wrap

req.l: Pickled onions: 1/2 red onion, thinly sliced; 1 garlic clove; zest and juice of 1/2 lime; 1 tbsp red wine vinegar; 1 tsp maple syrup; 1/4 cup cilantro; salt
2 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp ground coriander, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp dried thyme
Sauce: 1 chipotle in adobo, 3/4 cup plain yogurt, zest and juice of 1/2 lime, 2 tsp maple syrup, 1 garlic clove, 1/4 cup cilantro, water as needed

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the onion pickle ingredients and chill.
Dry the chickpeas, toss with 1 tbsp oil and salt, and roast 20 minutes. Add 1 tsp garlic powder and 1/2 tsp coriander and roast 2–3 more.
Toss the cauliflower with the remaining spices, salt and 1–2 tbsp oil and roast 20 minutes, tossing halfway.
Blend the sauce with salt, thinning with water.
Toss the chickpeas and cauliflower with a few spoons of sauce.
Spread sauce on warm pitas and fill with lettuce, the chickpea mix and pickled onions.

recipes.name: White Bean & Artichoke Bake

req.l: 1 tsp each oregano, thyme and red pepper flakes
1/2 cup breadcrumbs plus Parmesan, for topping

steps: Sauté the garlic in olive oil, add everything except the topping and simmer 5 minutes.
Transfer to a baking dish, top with breadcrumbs and Parmesan, and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes until golden.
recipes.note: Freezes beautifully.

recipes.name: Moroccan Chickpea Stew

req.l: 1 tsp each cumin, coriander, smoked paprika and cinnamon

steps: Sauté the onion and garlic, add the spices and harissa for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer 25 minutes.
Finish with lemon and cilantro. Serve over couscous or with crusty bread.

recipes.name: Turkish Red Lentil Soup

req.l: 2 tsp cumin, 1 1/2 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp turmeric
Butter and extra paprika, to finish

steps: Sauté the onion, carrot and garlic.
Add the spices, lentils and broth and simmer 25 minutes until the lentils dissolve.
Blend partially or fully, finish with lemon, and top with a butter-paprika drizzle.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Enchilada Casserole

req.l: 2 large sweet potatoes, roasted and cubed
1 1/2 cups shredded pepper jack or cheddar
1 tsp each cumin, chili powder and garlic powder

steps: Mix the sweet potatoes, beans, chiles and spices.
Layer sauce, tortillas, filling and cheese in a baking dish; repeat, finishing with sauce and cheese.
Bake at 375°F covered 35 minutes, then uncovered 10.
recipes.note: Freeze before or after baking.

recipes.name: Italian Sausage & White Bean Soup

req.l: 1 tsp each oregano, fennel seed and red pepper flakes

steps: Brown the sausage and remove.
Sauté the onion and garlic, add the spices, tomatoes, broth, beans and Parmesan rind and simmer 20 minutes.
Return the sausage and stir in the greens. Remove the rind before freezing.

recipes.name: Black Bean Chili

req.l: 1 can diced tomatoes with green chiles
1 tsp each cumin, smoked paprika, oregano and cinnamon

steps: Sauté the onion, pepper and garlic. Add the spices and cocoa for 1 minute.
Add everything else and simmer 30–40 minutes. Mash some beans against the pot to thicken.
recipes.note: Gets better after freezing.

recipes.name: Greek Pastitsio

req.l: 1/2 tsp each cinnamon, allspice and nutmeg
Béchamel: 4 tbsp butter, 4 tbsp flour, 2 1/2 cups warm milk, 2 eggs, 1/2 cup Parmesan

steps: Cook the pasta al dente.
Brown the meat with the onion and spices, add the tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Whisk a butter-flour roux with the warm milk until thick, cool slightly, then whisk in the eggs and Parmesan.
Layer pasta, meat sauce, pasta and béchamel. Bake at 375°F for 45 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Spinach & Feta Egg Casserole

req.l: 10 oz frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
Salt, pepper and red pepper flakes

steps: Whisk the eggs and milk, fold in everything else and pour into a greased 9 × 13.
Bake at 350°F for 35–40 minutes until set. Cool completely before cutting and freezing.

recipes.name: Chicken Tomatillo Stew
steps: Roast the tomatillos, onion, garlic and poblanos at 425°F for 20 minutes until charred, then blend with the green chiles.
Brown the chicken, add the sauce, spices and broth, and simmer 35 minutes.
Shred the chicken, finish with cilantro and lime, and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Turkey & Artichoke Stuffed Peppers

req.l: 6 bell peppers, tops cut off and seeded
1 cup cooked brown rice or farro
1 tsp each garlic powder, Italian seasoning and red pepper flakes
Shredded mozzarella, about 1/2 cup per pepper

steps: Brown the turkey with the spices and mix with the rice, artichokes and tomatoes.
Stuff the peppers and top with cheese.
Bake covered at 375°F for 40 minutes, uncovering for the last 10.
recipes.note: Cool and freeze individually for grab-and-reheat meals.

recipes.name: Chipotle-Lime Chicken Lunch Bowls

req.l: 2 chipotles in adobo plus 1 tbsp sauce, minced
2 1/2 cups cooked rice, tossed with lime and cilantro
2 cans black beans, rinsed and seasoned with cumin and salt

steps: Mix the chipotles, adobo, juice of 2 limes, oil, garlic, cumin and salt; marinate the chicken 30 minutes or overnight.
Roast the sweet potatoes with oil and salt at 425°F for 25 minutes. Roast or grill the chicken at 425°F for 18–22 minutes to 165°F, rest and slice.
Toss the cabbage with the remaining lime and a pinch of salt.
Divide rice (1/2 cup), beans (1/3 cup), sweet potato, 4 oz chicken and salsa among containers. Pack slaw and avocado separately.

recipes.name: Greek Sheet-Pan Chicken with Potatoes and Leeks

req.l: 2 leeks, cleaned and cut in 1-inch pieces

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and mix the oil, lemon, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
Toss the potatoes and carrots with half and roast 15 minutes.
Toss the chicken and leeks with the rest, add to the pan and roast 25 minutes more until the chicken reaches 175°F.
Finish with more lemon and fresh herbs.
recipes.note: Rinse leeks well; grit hides between the layers.

recipes.name: Roasted Red Potatoes

req.l: 3 lb red potatoes, halved or quartered
1 tsp dried thyme, 1/2 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp dried basil

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and grease a large sheet.
Toss everything except the parsley and spread on the sheet.
Bake 45–55 minutes, turning every 15, until browned and crisp. Sprinkle with parsley.

recipes.name: Shrimp Fajita Bowl

req.l: 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp salt

steps: Toss the shrimp with half the oil and the spices.
Char the peppers and onion in the remaining oil over high heat 6–7 minutes. Remove.
Sear the shrimp in one layer 1 1/2–2 minutes per side. Return the vegetables and squeeze over the lime.
Serve over 1/2 cup rice each with beans, salsa, yogurt and cilantro.
recipes.note: Cook the shrimp in batches so they sear instead of steam.

recipes.name: Kentucky Hot Brown

req.l: 1/2 cup Pecorino Romano, grated, plus more for topping
1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp white pepper

steps: Cook the bacon until crisp and set aside.
Toast the bread and arrange 2 slices in each of two broiler-safe dishes.
Make a roux with the butter and flour, cook 2 minutes, then whisk in the milk and cream and cook until thick, 5–6 minutes.
Off the heat, whisk in the yolk, then the Pecorino, salt and pepper.
Top the toast with turkey and tomato halves and ladle the sauce over everything.
Sprinkle with more cheese and broil 3–5 minutes until bubbly and spotted brown.
Cross 2 strips of bacon on each and garnish with parsley.
recipes.note: Use real roasted turkey, not deli meat. Bacon goes on after broiling so it stays crisp.

recipes.name: Lemon-Herb Roasted Chicken Thighs
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and mix the oil, lemon, garlic, oregano, paprika, salt and pepper.
Toss the thighs in the marinade (up to 8 hours ahead).
Roast on a sheet pan 25–30 minutes until 175°F and browned at the edges.
Rest 5 minutes. Shred some for toppings through the week and keep the rest whole.
recipes.note: Thighs stay juicy when reheated. Nutrition is per 5 oz cooked.

recipes.name: Golden Rule

req.l: Syrup: 1/2 cup honey, 1/2 cup hot water, 2–3 inches fresh ginger, sliced

steps: For the syrup, dissolve the honey in the hot water, add the ginger and simmer 5–10 minutes. Cool and strain. Keeps 2 weeks refrigerated.
Shake everything with ice 10–12 seconds and strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass.
Garnish with a lemon wheel or candied ginger.

recipes.name: Overnight Apple Cinnamon Oats
steps: Combine the oats, milk and chia in a jar.
Stir in the agave, cinnamon, vanilla and salt, then the apple and almonds.
Cover and refrigerate overnight. Loosen with a splash more milk in the morning.
recipes.note: Keeps 3 days. Add a spoonful of almond butter for more protein.

recipes.name: Apple Galette

req.l: 3 tbsp sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon
4 tbsp cold butter, in small cubes

steps: Pulse the flour, sugar and salt, pulse in the butter to wet sand, then add ice water until a ball forms. Wrap and chill at least 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 375°F. Roll the dough to a 12-inch circle on a lined tray and lightly press a 9-inch pan in the center as a guide.
Peel, core and slice the apples very thin, fan them within the circle, sprinkle with cinnamon sugar and dot with butter.
Fold the edge over the apples, brush with egg wash and bake 30–40 minutes until golden. Serve with ice cream.

recipes.name: Gravy

req.l: 4 cups chicken or turkey stock (with strained drippings)
4 tbsp unsalted butter or drippings fat

steps: Melt the butter, whisk in the flour and cook 2–3 minutes until golden.
Whisk in the warm stock about 1/2 cup at a time until smooth.
Simmer 8–10 minutes until thickened. Season with salt, pepper and Worcestershire. Strain for extra smooth gravy.

recipes.name: Mexican Corn Stew

req.l: 2 tsp ground cumin, 2 tsp ground coriander
Crushed tortilla chips, salsa and nonfat yogurt, to serve

steps: Cook the onion and garlic in the oil over medium-high 3–5 minutes.
Add the jalapeños, carrots, celery and peppers for 3 minutes.
Add the cilantro, liquid, corn, spices and beans.
Cover and cook on low until thick, 1 1/2–2 hours on the stove or 6–8 hours in a slow cooker. Add cayenne to taste.
Top with crushed chips, salsa and yogurt.
recipes.note: Biggest upgrade: toast the cumin and coriander and caramelize a tablespoon of tomato paste with the onion before adding liquid. A chipotle in adobo, charred corn and a squeeze of lime at the end all help too.

recipes.name: Creamy Vegan Lemon Pasta

req.l: 1 (15-oz) can small white beans, drained and rinsed
1/4 cup cashew parmesan or nutritional yeast

steps: Cook the pasta.
Sauté the onion in 2 tbsp oil about 5 minutes until golden, then the garlic 1–2 minutes.
Blend the beans, onion and garlic with all the remaining sauce ingredients until completely smooth.
Sauté the asparagus in the same pan 5–10 minutes.
Toss the pasta with the asparagus and sauce and top with pepper flakes and more parmesan.

recipes.name: Old-Fashioned Buttermilk Donut Bars

req.l: Glaze: 1 tsp vanilla bean paste (or vanilla extract)
Glaze: 1-2 tbsp milk, as needed to thin

steps: Heat oven to 350F and grease or parchment-line a 9x13 pan.
Whisk flour, baking powder, baking soda, nutmeg, and salt in a bowl.
Cream the softened butter and sugar until fluffy, beat in eggs one at a time, then add vanilla.
Add the dry mix and buttermilk alternately, beginning and ending with dry, mixing just until combined.
Spread batter in the pan and bake 22-25 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean; cool completely.

For the glaze, cook butter in a small saucepan over medium heat until golden and nutty, then take off the heat and whisk in powdered sugar, maple syrup, and vanilla bean paste, thinning with milk if needed.
Spread the warm glaze over the cooled bars and let it set 10-15 minutes before slicing.
recipes.note: Store glazed bars airtight at room temperature up to 2 days. To freeze, freeze unglazed and glaze after thawing.

recipes.name: Mackinac Island Fudge
steps: Bring butter, both sugars, milk, and salt to a boil in a saucepan, then cook on low for 6 minutes, stirring the whole time.
Cool briefly, then stir in vanilla, cocoa, and confectioners' sugar until smooth.
Turn the fudge out onto a baking sheet or silicone mat to cool, form it into a log, wrap in plastic, and chill about 30 minutes.
recipes.note: Keeps about 2 weeks refrigerated in a covered container or up to 3 months frozen. Do not cook the caramel past 6 minutes or it can scorch.

recipes.name: Conference

req.l: 1 tsp demerara syrup (2 parts demerara sugar dissolved in 1 part water)

steps: Stir everything over ice and strain into a double rocks glass over one large cube.
Garnish with the lemon and orange twists.

recipes.name: Banana Cream Pie Overnight Oats
steps: Mash the bananas in a large bowl.
Stir in everything except the peanut butter until there are no dry pockets.
Rest 5 minutes, stir again, and divide among 5 jars. Refrigerate overnight (up to 5 days).
Top each jar with 1 tbsp peanut butter. Eat cold or microwave 90 seconds.

recipes.name: Roasted Chickpea & Kale Wrap
steps: Toss the chickpeas with the oil, soy, maple, paprika and 1/2 tsp garlic powder and air fry at 400°F for 10–11 minutes (15–18 in the oven).
Mix the mayo, lemon, remaining garlic powder and salt and toss with the kale.
Spread the tortilla with hummus, add the kale, chickpeas, avocado and tomato, and roll tightly.
Toast in a pan 1–2 minutes per side and halve.

recipes.name: Lemon-Herb Chicken Thighs with Roasted Roots
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and toss the vegetables with the oil, salt and pepper.
Roast alongside the chicken 25–30 minutes, flipping halfway.
Serve the chicken with the vegetables, 1/2 cup farro each, and lemon.
recipes.note: Roast a double tray of vegetables for lunches.

recipes.name: Double-Apple Crumble Cake

req.l: 3 tbsp unsalted butter, plus more for the pan
4 medium Pink Lady apples, peeled, cored and sliced 1/4 inch thick
1/2 cup crème fraîche or sour cream

steps: Cook the apples in the butter over medium, tossing, 10–15 minutes until slightly translucent. Cool.
Heat the oven to 350°F. Butter a 9-inch springform and line the bottom with parchment.
Whisk the flour, cinnamon, leaveners and salt. Whisk the apple butter, sugar, crème fraîche, oil, eggs and vanilla.
Whisk wet into dry just until even, then fold in the apples, leaving the liquid behind.
Spread in the pan, top with crumble and bake 1 hour 20 minutes to 1 hour 30 minutes until a tester comes out clean. Cool completely.
recipes.note: Keeps 4 days wrapped. Use apple butter that's just apples.

recipes.name: Pico de Gallo
steps: Cut slices from the four sides of each tomato (skipping the seedy core) and dice them.
Toss with the onion, jalapeños, lime juice and oil. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.name: Salted Caramel Blondies

req.l: 12 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted and cooled
1/2 cup caramel bits, or 12 unwrapped caramel squares

steps: Heat oven to 350F, line a 13x9 pan with a parchment sling, and coat with baking spray.
Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt together.
In another bowl, stir brown sugar and melted butter until smooth, then whisk in eggs and vanilla.
Fold the dry ingredients into the wet with a spatula, then fold in the white chocolate chips.
Microwave caramel and cream at half power in 30-second bursts, stirring between, until smooth; let cool until pourable.
Spread the batter in the pan, drizzle with caramel, and swirl by dragging a knife across the drizzle lines.
Bake 30-35 minutes, rotating halfway, until shiny, lightly cracked, and set rather than jiggly.
Sprinkle flaky salt over the top as soon as it comes out of the oven.
Cool 10 minutes in the pan, lift out by the parchment, cool fully on a rack, and cut into bars.
recipes.note: Bars freeze well; flash-freeze in a single layer or separate with parchment, then thaw or microwave 10-15 seconds.

recipes.name: Rockfish Tacos with Cabbage Slaw

req.l: 1 tsp chili powder, 1/2 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp salt

steps: Rub the fish with the spices and salt.
Toss the cabbage with the yogurt, half the lime and a pinch of salt.
Cook the fish in the oil over medium-high 3 minutes per side until it flakes. Break up and squeeze over the remaining lime.
Char the tortillas and fill with fish, slaw, avocado, salsa and cilantro.

recipes.name: Beef Ragù

req.l: 2 1/2 lb beef chuck roast, in 2-inch chunks
3 bay leaves, 4 thyme sprigs, 2 rosemary sprigs, 3 sage leaves
Pappardelle, Parmigiano-Reggiano and olive oil, to serve

steps: Pat the beef dry, season well and let it sit 30 minutes.
Sear in batches in the oil in a Dutch oven until deeply browned. Set aside and lower the heat.
Cook the onion, carrot and celery with a pinch of salt 15–20 minutes until caramelized. Add the garlic and pepper flakes, then the tomato paste until rust-colored.
Deglaze with the wine and reduce by half. Add the tomatoes, stock, Worcestershire, herbs, rind and beef.
Simmer partially covered on low 2 1/2–3 hours until fork-tender.
Shred the meat, discard the herbs and rind, and simmer uncovered 15–20 minutes. Season and stir in the basil.
Toss with pasta and a splash of pasta water; finish with cheese, olive oil and basil.
recipes.note: Better the next day. Keeps 3 days refrigerated or 3 months frozen.

recipes.name: Korean Gochujang Noodles

req.l: 8 oz rice noodles or noodles of choice
2 tbsp hot honey or brown sugar
Scallions, sesame seeds and cilantro, to serve

steps: Cook the noodles, drain, rinse and toss with the butter.
Sauté the chicken until cooked through.
Whisk the sauce ingredients.
Toss the noodles with half the sauce, then add the chicken and the rest and heat through over low.
Top with scallions, sesame seeds and cilantro.

recipes.name: Seared Sea Scallops with Lime and Chili
steps: Season the scallops with salt, pepper and garlic and sear in the butter.
Slice each into four horizontal rounds and arrange on plates.
Sprinkle with lime juice, salt and crushed chilies and let sit 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Spicy Sambal Beans & Rice

req.l: 1 cup jasmine or basmati rice (or 2 cups cooked)
1 (15-oz) can black, kidney or navy beans, drained and rinsed
Juice of 1/2 lime (or 1 tbsp rice vinegar)
Optional: 1 cup spinach or kale, 1/2 cup frozen peas or corn, a fried egg

steps: Cook the rice.
Soften the onion in the oil 3–5 minutes, then the garlic 30 seconds.
Bloom the sambal 1 minute, then add the beans, soy and sugar for 3–4 minutes. Wilt in any greens or vegetables.
Toss in the rice until coated and hot. Finish with lime and salt.
Top with a fried egg, scallions or extra sambal.

recipes.name: Sides and Sauces (Quick Set)

req.l: Lemon-yogurt sauce: 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, zest and juice of 1/2 lemon, 1 tbsp chopped dill, salt
Quick tzatziki: 1 cup Greek yogurt, 1/2 cucumber grated and squeezed dry, 1 garlic clove grated, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp dill, salt
Shaved Brussels sprout salad: 8 oz Brussels sprouts thinly sliced, 1 apple in matchsticks, juice of 1 lemon, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 oz shaved Parmesan, salt and pepper
Arugula and apple salad: 4 cups arugula, 1 apple thinly sliced, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp cider vinegar, salt
Arugula and white bean salad: 4 cups arugula, 1 can white beans, 1/2 red onion thinly sliced, juice of 1/2 lemon, 1 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper
Apple-cabbage slaw: 2 cups shredded cabbage, 1 apple in matchsticks, 2 tbsp Greek yogurt, juice of 1 lime, salt
Big kale salad: kale, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, grated carrot, pepitas or walnuts

steps: Mix each one just before serving. Slaws improve after 15 minutes.
For the kale salad, massage the kale with lemon, oil and salt for 1 minute before adding the carrot and nuts.
recipes.note: Tzatziki keeps 4 days, so make it ahead.

recipes.name: Mexican Salad
steps: Sear the corn in the oil with the jalapeño and onion.
Toss with the cilantro, beans, tomatoes, bell pepper and a good squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Butter Beans with Ricotta, Lemon + Basil Pesto

req.l: 4–5 tbsp olive oil, plus extra to serve
1 jar butter beans, with half the liquid

steps: Blend the pine nuts, basil, garlic, Parmesan and oil into a loose pesto.
Warm the beans gently with half their liquid, or serve them cold.
Spoon onto a platter, dollop with ricotta, drizzle with pesto, and finish with lemon zest and juice, black pepper and olive oil.

recipes.name: Eggs n' Tuna n' Rice
steps: Warm the rice and top with the tuna and the egg.
Stir the gochujang and mayo together and drizzle over.

recipes.name: Waldorf Salad

req.l: Olive oil, sherry vinegar, Dijon mustard and minced shallot, for the dressing

steps: Toast the walnuts in a dry skillet.
Toss the fruit and greens with the walnuts and the dressing. Top with cheese if you like.

recipes.name: Sausage Ricotta Hot Honey Pizza

req.l: 1/2 cup pizza sauce or crushed San Marzano tomatoes
1/2 cup cooked spicy Italian sausage, crumbled

steps: Heat the oven to 475°F with a pizza stone or baking sheet inside.
Roll the dough out on a floured surface and move it to parchment.
Spread on the sauce, then add the mozzarella and crumbled sausage.
Dot with spoonfuls of ricotta, add the pepper flakes if using, and drizzle with olive oil.
Slide the pizza, parchment and all, onto the hot stone and bake 10 to 12 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese bubbles.
Finish with a drizzle of hot honey and basil, then slice.
recipes.note: Makes one large pizza, about 8 slices; a serving is 2 slices.

recipes.name: Rosemary and Cranberry Soda Bread

req.l: 450 g plain flour, plus extra for dusting
350 ml buttermilk, plus a little extra if needed

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Sift the flour, baking soda and salt, stir in the cranberries and rosemary, and make a well.
Add the buttermilk and mix quickly into a soft dough, adding a splash more if needed.
Knead lightly, shape into a 6-inch round on a baking sheet and cut a deep cross on top.
Bake 15 minutes, then at 400°F for 20–25 more until golden and hollow-sounding underneath.
Cool 20 minutes and serve warm with butter.

recipes.name: Hummus

req.l: 1 g baking soda (optional, for canned chickpeas)

steps: Optional for extra creaminess: simmer the chickpeas with water and the baking soda 5–7 minutes, drain, rinse and rub off loose skins.
Blend the tahini and lemon 1 minute until pale and fluffy.
Add the garlic, cumin and salt for 30 seconds, then the chickpeas for 1–2 minutes.
With the machine running, stream in the oil, then cold water a tablespoon at a time until smooth and light. Adjust to taste.
recipes.note: A serving is about 40 g. Blend in roasted red pepper, herbs or a spoonful of Greek yogurt for variations.

recipes.name: Easy Coleslaw
steps: Whisk the vinegar, oil, salt, pepper and sugar until dissolved.
Toss with the slaw mix, cover and refrigerate 1–24 hours.
Drain excess liquid before serving.

recipes.name: Almond Butter Banana Bread

req.l: 1 tsp + 1/2 cup virgin coconut oil, melted

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Oil a 4 1/2 × 8 1/2 loaf pan and line with a parchment sling.
Stir 3 tbsp almond butter, 1 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp coconut oil into a swirl mixture.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt, baking soda and cardamom.
Whisk the eggs with the remaining sugar 30 seconds, then the banana, yogurt, vanilla, remaining almond butter and coconut oil.
Whisk into the dry ingredients until smooth, then fold in the almonds.
Pour into the pan, dollop the swirl mixture on top and drag figure eights through it.
Bake 60–70 minutes until a tester comes out clean. Cool 20 minutes, lift out and cool completely.
recipes.note: Keeps 4 days. Use truly overripe bananas.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Salmon with Broccoli and Cauliflower
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the vegetables with 1 tbsp oil, garlic powder, salt and pepper and roast 12 minutes.
Push the vegetables aside, add the salmon, brush with the remaining oil, season and top with lemon slices.
Roast 10–12 minutes until the salmon flakes (125–130°F for medium).
Serve with 1/2 cup farro each and a squeeze of lemon.
recipes.note: Roast a second tray of vegetables for weekday lunches.

recipes.name: Breakfast Tacos

req.l: 1 large handful kale or chard, chopped
Salt, pepper and 1/2 tsp olive oil

steps: Wilt the greens in the oil with a pinch of salt over medium, 2 minutes.
Whisk the eggs and whites, add to the pan and scramble gently until just set. Fold in the beans.
Char the tortillas over a flame or in a dry pan about 30 seconds per side.
Fill the tortillas and top with salsa.
recipes.note: Sauté the whole bunch of greens ahead so weekday tacos take five minutes.

recipes.name: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet.
Brown the butter until deep amber and nutty, 5–7 minutes. Cool.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt.
Whisk the brown butter with both sugars 1–2 minutes, then the egg and vanilla 2–3 minutes.
Fold in the dry ingredients, then the chocolate chips.
Scoop onto the sheet with space between and bake 12 minutes until crisp at the edges and gooey in the center. Cool on the sheet.

recipes.name: Stuffing

req.l: 1 lb bread (white and sourdough or French), cubed and dried
1/4 cup fresh parsley, 1 tbsp fresh sage, 1 tbsp fresh thyme, 1 tbsp fresh rosemary
1 tsp kosher salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper

steps: Dry the bread cubes in a 300°F oven 10–15 minutes if not stale.
Soften the onions and celery in the butter 8–10 minutes, add the garlic for 1 minute, then the herbs, salt and pepper for 1 minute.
Toss with the bread, plus cranberries and nuts if using.
Moisten with 2 cups stock, adding more 1/4 cup at a time if dry, then stir in the eggs.
Bake in a greased 9 × 13 at 350°F covered 30 minutes, then uncovered 20–25 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Marcona Almond Cookies

req.l: 4 oz Marcona almonds, plus about 24 whole for topping

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet.
Pulse the almonds until coarse, then add the almond paste, sugar, vanilla, the whole egg and one egg white and process until smooth. Beat the yolk with 2 tsp water for egg wash.
Pipe or scoop 1 1/2-inch rounds onto the sheet, brush with egg wash and press an almond into each.
Bake 10–12 minutes until puffed and golden. Cool completely before peeling off.
recipes.note: Keeps 5 days or 2 months frozen. Salted roasted cashews work if you can't find Marconas.

recipes.name: Chicken Tinga Tostadas

req.l: 2 chipotles in adobo plus 1 tbsp sauce
1/2 cup refried or mashed black beans

steps: Blend the tomatoes, chipotles, adobo, garlic, oregano and salt.
Soften the onion in the oil, add the sauce and whole thighs and simmer covered 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken in the sauce and simmer uncovered 5 minutes until thick.
Spread beans on each tostada and top with tinga, slaw, cheese and cilantro. Two per person.
recipes.note: Tinga freezes well; double it for a future lunch.

recipes.name: Key Lime Pie Bars
steps: Heat the oven to 300°F. Mix the crumbs, brown sugar and butter, press into a 9 × 13 pan and bake 15 minutes. Cool.
Whisk the condensed milk, yolks, lime juice and 2 tbsp zest, pour into the crust and bake 25–30 minutes until set with a slight jiggle. Cool completely.
Whip the cream with the sugar and vanilla to soft peaks, spread over the top and sprinkle with the remaining zest.

recipes.name: Mayonnaise

req.l: 1 3/4 cups vegetable, canola or grapeseed oil

steps: Whisk the yolks well, then 1/2 tbsp vinegar, the salt and mustard.
Whisk in the oil in a very slow, steady stream; once it emulsifies you can go a little faster. Thin with vinegar if it gets too thick.
Whisk in any remaining vinegar and season with lemon and salt.

recipes.name: Cilantro Lime Bean Salad

req.l: Pickled jalapeños: 2 tbsp white wine vinegar, 1/2 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp kosher salt, 1 jalapeño thinly sliced, 2 tbsp cilantro minced
1 (15-oz) can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Whisk the vinegar, sugar and salt until dissolved, add the sliced jalapeño and cilantro, and set aside.
Massage the red onion with the zest and juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt until it softens.
Halve the cucumber, smash it with the flat of a knife, cut into 1-inch pieces, salt and let drain 10 minutes, then squeeze out the water.
Warm the oil over medium-low and cook the garlic until golden, 2–3 minutes.
Blend the garlic oil with the chopped jalapeño, the second lime's zest and juice, vinegar, agave, miso, 1/3 cup cilantro and salt until smooth.
Toss the onions, beans, cucumber and remaining cilantro with the dressing.
Spread salted mashed avocado on tostadas, top with bean salad and pickled jalapeños.

recipes.name: Banana Nut Chia Pudding

req.l: 1 banana, plus extra slices to serve
3/4 cup unsweetened soy or other plant milk
Crumble: 2 medjool dates, 1/3 cup pecans, 1/2 tsp cinnamon, pinch of salt

steps: Blend the banana, milk, yogurt, maple, pecans, vanilla, spices and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Whisk into the chia seeds, rest 5 minutes, whisk again, cover and chill at least an hour.
Pulse the crumble ingredients until crumbly, without turning it to paste.
Layer crumble, pudding and more crumble, and top with banana.
recipes.note: Blend in protein powder (plus 1/4–1/2 cup extra milk) for more protein.

recipes.name: Bean and Cheese Burrito
steps: Warm the beans, spread on the tortilla, top with cheese and enchilada sauce, and roll.
Toast seam-side down in a skillet until crisp.
recipes.note: Marked "needs improvement" in your notes. Calories are from your own tally; adding egg or Greek yogurt would lift the protein.

recipes.name: Bourbon BBQ Bacon Cheeseburger Meatball Subs
steps: Preheat oven to 375F.
Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg, and seasonings just until combined, then roll into 16-20 meatballs about 1.5 inches wide.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium and brown the meatballs on all sides in a single layer, 5-7 minutes, working in batches if needed.
Put all meatballs back in the pan, add the BBQ sauce, reduce heat, and simmer 10 minutes, stirring gently.
Meanwhile, split the rolls lengthwise without cutting through and toast them on a baking sheet in the oven about 5 minutes.
Fill each roll with 4-5 meatballs plus extra sauce, then top with 1/4 cup cheddar and 2 slices bacon.
Bake 2-3 minutes more until the cheese melts and serve immediately.
recipes.note: Meatballs can be made ahead and frozen raw or cooked for up to 3 months. Let them sear before turning so they hold together.

recipes.name: Chickpea, Beet & Feta Salad with Lemon-Garlic Vinaigrette
steps: Whisk the oil, lemon, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the beets, chickpeas, carrot, feta, onion and parsley and toss.

recipes.name: Curried Chickpea Salad

req.l: 1 tsp curry powder, 1/4 tsp turmeric, 1/8 tsp garam masala

steps: Whisk the oil, lime, vinegar, curry powder, maple, salt, turmeric and garam masala in a large bowl.
Stir in the chickpeas, celery, raisins, onion and cilantro.
Serve over greens, topped with cashews.

recipes.name: Green Goddess Smashed Potato Salad

req.l: 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
Dressing: 1 cup unsweetened plain plant-based yogurt
Dressing: zest and juice of 1 lime
Dressing: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
Dressing: 1/2 cup fresh dill, woody stems removed
Dressing: 1/2 cup fresh parsley, woody stems removed
Dressing: 1/4 tsp kosher salt, or more as needed

steps: Boil the potatoes in well-salted water about 10 minutes, then cool.
Blend all dressing ingredients with an immersion blender until smooth and adjust salt.
Dry the rinsed chickpeas thoroughly with a towel.
Heat oven to 425F. Toss potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, the nutritional yeast, and salt, place on half of a baking sheet, and gently smash.
Toss chickpeas with 1 tbsp oil and salt, spread on the other half of the sheet, and roast on the lower rack 20 minutes.
Scatter the minced dill and 1 tsp garlic powder over the tray, toss, and roast 10-15 minutes more.
Toss broccoli with the remaining oil, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, coriander, thyme, and salt, and roast cut side down on the middle rack 20-25 minutes until browned underneath; chop roughly.
Massage kale with 2 tbsp dressing and a pinch of salt, then add romaine, broccoli, potatoes, and 1/2 cup dressing and toss.
Divide among plates and finish with chickpeas, pickled onions, and more dressing.
recipes.note: Potatoes, dressing, and dried chickpeas can all be prepped ahead and refrigerated. Get the chickpeas as dry as possible so they crisp.

recipes.name: Yuca-Vegetable Chili

req.l: 1/2 red or green bell pepper, chopped
6 ripe tomatoes, peeled, seeded and chopped

steps: Simmer the yuca in salted water with the lime juice until tender, 35–40 minutes.
Meanwhile cook the onion, garlic, jalapeño and pepper in the margarine over medium.
Add the chickpeas with their liquid and the tomatoes and cook 3 minutes.
Drain the yuca, add it, and cook about 10 minutes until the flavors blend.
Top with scallions, cilantro and cheese.
recipes.note: Low in protein as written; doubling the chickpeas or adding Greek yogurt on top helps.

recipes.name: Baked Apple Cider Donuts (Triple Batch)
recipes.timeText: 40 min (plus about 40 min to reduce the cider)

req.l: 180 g (about 1 1/2 sticks plus 1 tbsp) unsalted butter
Topping: 1 tbsp ground cinnamon, 1 1/2 tsp apple pie spice
About 3/4 cup reserved cider-butter mixture, to top

steps: Simmer the cider over low heat, stirring now and then, until it's down to about 2 1/4 cups. A triple batch takes longer than the original's 20 minutes, so use your widest pot and start checking at 25 minutes. Stir in the butter until melted and let cool 10 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F and spray the donut pan.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the sugar, eggs, sour cream, vanilla and 1 1/2 cups of the cider-butter mixture. Keep the rest (about 3/4 cup) for the topping.
Fold the wet mix into the dry just until combined; the batter will be fairly thick.
Pipe the batter from a zip-top or pastry bag into the pan, filling each cavity about halfway.
Bake 9 to 10 minutes, until lightly browned and springy when pressed. Cool 2 minutes in the pan, then move to a rack. Re-spray and repeat until the batter is gone (27 donuts, so several rounds).
Stir the topping sugar, cinnamon and apple pie spice together. Dip each warm donut on both sides in the reserved cider-butter, then toss in the spiced sugar.
recipes.note: Tripled from Mike Bakes NYC's 9-donut recipe. Macros are per donut and come from the source. Best the day they're made; keep leftovers covered at room temperature up to 2 days.
